Turns any input (code, docs, papers, images, videos) into a persistent knowledge graph with god nodes, community detection, and query/path/explain tools.
- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.

55	func (s *APIV1Service) CreateAttachment(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.CreateAttachmentRequest) (*v1pb.Attachment, error) {
56		user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
57		if err != nil {
58			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get current user: %v", err)
59		}
60		if user == nil {
61			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
62		}
63	
64		// Validate required fields
65		if request.Attachment == nil {
66			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "attachment is required")
67		}
68		if request.Attachment.Filename == "" {
69			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "filename is required")
70		}
71		if !validateFilename(request.Attachment.Filename) {
72			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "filename contains invalid characters or format")
73		}
74		normalizedMimeType := request.Attachment.Type
75		if normalizedMimeType == "" {
76			ext := filepath.Ext(request.Attachment.Filename)
77			mimeType := mime.TypeByExtension(ext)
78			if mimeType == "" {
79				mimeType = http.DetectContentType(request.Attachment.Content)
80			}
81			if normalizedType, ok := normalizeMimeType(mimeType); ok {
82				normalizedMimeType = normalizedType
83			}
84		}
85		if normalizedMimeType == "" {
86			normalizedMimeType = "application/octet-stream"
87		}
88		normalizedType, ok := normalizeMimeType(normalizedMimeType)
89		if !ok {
90			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid MIME type format")
91		}
92		request.Attachment.Type = normalizedType
93	
94		attachmentUID, err := ValidateAndGenerateUID(request.AttachmentId)
95		if err != nil {
96			return nil, err
97		}
98	
99		create := &store.Attachment{
100			UID:       attachmentUID,
101			CreatorID: user.ID,
102			Filename:  request.Attachment.Filename,
103			Type:      request.Attachment.Type,
104		}
105	
106		inputMotionMedia, err := validateClientMotionMedia(request.Attachment.MotionMedia, attachmentUID)
107		if err != nil {
108			return nil, err
109		}
110		if inputMotionMedia != nil {
111			create.Payload = ensureAttachmentPayload(create.Payload)
112			create.Payload.MotionMedia = inputMotionMedia
113		}
114	
115		instanceStorageSetting, err := s.Store.GetInstanceStorageSetting(ctx)
116		if err != nil {
117			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get instance storage setting: %v", err)
118		}
119		size := binary.Size(request.Attachment.Content)
120		uploadSizeLimit := int(instanceStorageSetting.UploadSizeLimitMb) * MebiByte
121		if uploadSizeLimit == 0 {
122			uploadSizeLimit = MaxUploadBufferSizeBytes
123		}
124		if size > uploadSizeLimit {
125			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "file size exceeds the limit")
126		}
127		create.Size = int64(size)
128		create.Blob = request.Attachment.Content
129	
130		if request.Attachment.Memo != nil {
131			memoUID, err := ExtractMemoUIDFromName(*request.Attachment.Memo)
132			if err != nil {
133				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo name: %v", err)
134			}
135			memo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{UID: &memoUID})
136			if err != nil {
137				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to find memo: %v", err)
138			}
139			if memo == nil {
140				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found: %s", *request.Attachment.Memo)
141			}
142			if !canModifyMemo(user, memo) {
143				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
144			}
145			create.MemoID = &memo.ID
146		}
147	
148		if create.Payload == nil || create.Payload.MotionMedia == nil {
149			if detectedMotion := detectAndroidMotionMedia(create.Blob, create.Type, attachmentUID); detectedMotion != nil {
150				create.Payload = ensureAttachmentPayload(create.Payload)
151				create.Payload.MotionMedia = detectedMotion
152			}
153		}
154	
155		// Strip EXIF metadata from images for privacy protection.
156		// This removes sensitive information like GPS location, device details, etc.
157		if shouldStripExif(create.Type) && !isAndroidMotionContainer(create.Payload.GetMotionMedia()) {
158			release, err := s.acquireImageProcessingSlot(ctx)
159			if err != nil {
160				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.ResourceExhausted, "too many image processing requests")
161			}
162			strippedBlob, stripErr := stripImageExif(create.Blob, create.Type)
163			release()
164			if stripErr != nil {
165				// Log warning but continue with original image to ensure uploads don't fail.
166				slog.Warn("failed to strip EXIF metadata from image",
167					slog.String("type", create.Type),
168					slog.String("filename", create.Filename),
169					slog.String("error", stripErr.Error()))
170			} else {
171				create.Blob = strippedBlob
172				create.Size = int64(len(strippedBlob))
173			}
174		}
175	
176		if err := SaveAttachmentBlob(ctx, s.Profile, s.Store, create); err != nil {

178		}
179

181		if err != nil {
182			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create attachment: %v", err)
183		}
184	
185		return convertAttachmentFromStore(attachment), nil

188	func (s *APIV1Service) ListAttachments(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.ListAttachmentsRequest) (*v1pb.ListAttachmentsResponse, error) {
189		user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
190		if err != nil {
191			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get current user: %v", err)
192		}
193		if user == nil {
194			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
195		}
196	
197		pageSize := normalizePageSize(request.PageSize)
198	
199		// Parse page token for offset
200		offset := 0
201		if request.PageToken != "" {
202			// Simple implementation: page token is the offset as string
203			// In production, you might want to use encrypted tokens
204			if parsed, err := fmt.Sscanf(request.PageToken, "%d", &offset); err != nil || parsed != 1 {
205				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid page token")
206			}
207		}
208	
209		findAttachment := &store.FindAttachment{
210			CreatorID: &user.ID,
211			Limit:     &pageSize,
212			Offset:    &offset,
213		}
214	
215		// Parse filter if provided
216		if request.Filter != "" {
217			if err := s.validateAttachmentFilter(ctx, request.Filter); err != nil {
218				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid filter: %v", err)
219			}
220			findAttachment.Filters = append(findAttachment.Filters, request.Filter)
221		}
222	
223		attachments, err := s.Store.ListAttachments(ctx, findAttachment)
224		if err != nil {
225			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list attachments: %v", err)
226		}
227	
228		response := &v1pb.ListAttachmentsResponse{}
229	
230		for _, attachment := range attachments {
231			response.Attachments = append(response.Attachments, convertAttachmentFromStore(attachment))
232		}
233	
234		// Set next page token if we got the full page size (indicating there might be more)
235		if len(attachments) == pageSize {
236			response.NextPageToken = fmt.Sprintf("%d", offset+pageSize)
237		}
238	
239		return response, nil
240	}

343	func (s *APIV1Service) BatchDeleteAttachments(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.BatchDeleteAttachmentsRequest) (*emptypb.Empty, error) {
344		user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
345		if err != nil {
346			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get current user: %v", err)
347		}
348		if user == nil {

350		}
351		if len(request.Names) == 0 {
352			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "attachment names are required")
353		}
354		if len(request.Names) > maxBatchDeleteAttachments {
355			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "too many attachment names; max %d", maxBatchDeleteAttachments)
356		}
357	
358		attachments := make([]*store.Attachment, 0, len(request.Names))
359		seen := make(map[string]bool, len(request.Names))
360		for _, name := range request.Names {
361			if name == "" {
362				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "attachment name is required")
363			}
364			if seen[name] {
365				continue
366			}
367			seen[name] = true
368	
369			attachmentUID, err := ExtractAttachmentUIDFromName(name)
370			if err != nil {
371				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid attachment id: %v", err)
372			}
373			attachment, err := s.Store.GetAttachment(ctx, &store.FindAttachment{UID: &attachmentUID})
374			if err != nil {
375				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get attachment: %v", err)
376			}
377			if attachment == nil {
378				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "attachment not found")
379			}
380			if attachment.CreatorID != user.ID && !isSuperUser(user) {
381				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
382			}
383			attachments = append(attachments, attachment)
384		}

387			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to delete attachments: %v", err)

419	// checkAttachmentAccess verifies the user has permission to access the attachment.
420	// For unlinked attachments (no memo), only the creator can access.

422	func (s *APIV1Service) checkAttachmentAccess(ctx context.Context, attachment *store.Attachment) error {
423		user, _ := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
424	
425		// For unlinked attachments, only the creator can access.
426		if attachment.MemoID == nil {
427			if user == nil {
428				return status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
429			}
430			if attachment.CreatorID != user.ID && !isSuperUser(user) {
431				return status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
432			}
433			return nil
434		}
435	
436		// For linked attachments, check memo visibility.
437		memo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{ID: attachment.MemoID})
438		if err != nil {
439			return status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get memo: %v", err)
440		}
441		if memo == nil {
442			return status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
443		}
444	
445		if memo.Visibility == store.Public {
446			return nil
447		}
448		if user == nil {
449			return status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
450		}
451		if memo.Visibility == store.Private && memo.CreatorID != user.ID && !isSuperUser(user) {
452			return status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
453		}
454		return nil
455	}

202	func (s *Store) deleteAttachmentStorageImpl(ctx context.Context, attachment *Attachment, instanceStorageSetting *storepb.InstanceStorageSetting) error {
203		if attachment == nil {
204			return nil
205		}
206		if shouldFailDeleteAttachmentStorage(ctx) {
207			return ErrDeleteAttachmentStorageFailpoint
208		}
209	
210		if attachment.StorageType == storepb.AttachmentStorageType_LOCAL {
211			if err := func() error {
212				p := filepath.FromSlash(attachment.Reference)
213				if !filepath.IsAbs(p) {
214					p = filepath.Join(s.profile.Data, p)

219				}
220				return nil
221			}(); err != nil {
222				return err
223			}

225			if err := func() error {
226				s3ObjectPayload := attachment.Payload.GetS3Object()
227				if s3ObjectPayload == nil {
228					return errors.Errorf("No s3 object found")
229				}
230				s3Config := s3ObjectPayload.S3Config
231				if s3Config == nil {
232					if instanceStorageSetting == nil {
233						var err error
234						instanceStorageSetting, err = s.GetInstanceStorageSetting(ctx)
235						if err != nil {
236							return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get instance storage setting")
237						}
238					}
239					if instanceStorageSetting.S3Config == nil {
240						return errors.Errorf("S3 config is not found")
241					}
242					s3Config = instanceStorageSetting.S3Config
243				}
244	
245				s3Client, err := s3.NewClient(ctx, s3Config)
246				if err != nil {
247					return errors.Wrap(err, "Failed to create s3 client")
248				}
249				if err := s3Client.DeleteObject(ctx, s3ObjectPayload.Key); err != nil {
250					return errors.Wrap(err, "Failed to delete s3 object")
251				}
252				return nil
253			}(); err != nil {
254				return err
255			}
256		}
257	
258		s.deleteAttachmentDerivedCaches(attachment)
259		return nil
260	}

101	func (s *Server) Start(ctx context.Context) error {
102		var address, network string
103		if len(s.Profile.UNIXSock) == 0 {
104			address = fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", s.Profile.Addr, s.Profile.Port)
105			network = "tcp"
106		} else {
107			address = s.Profile.UNIXSock
108			network = "unix"
109		}
110		listener, err := net.Listen(network, address)
111		if err != nil {
112			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to listen")
113		}
114	
115		if network == "unix" {
116			if err := os.Chmod(address, 0660); err != nil {
117				_ = listener.Close()
118				return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to chmod socket")
119			}
120		}
121	
122		// Start Echo server directly (no cmux needed - all traffic is HTTP).
123		s.httpServer = &http.Server{Handler: s.echoServer}
124		go func() {
125			if err := s.httpServer.Serve(listener); err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {
126				slog.Error("failed to start echo server", "error", err)
127			}
128		}()
129		s.startBackgroundRunners(ctx)
130	
131		return nil
132	}

148		}

150		slog.Info("memos stopped properly")
151	}

153	func (s *Server) startBackgroundRunners(ctx context.Context) {
154		// Create a separate context for each background runner
155		// This allows us to control cancellation for each runner independently
156		s3Context, s3Cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
157	
158		// Store the cancel function so we can properly shut down runners
159		s.backgroundRunnerCancels = append(s.backgroundRunnerCancels, s3Cancel)
160	
161		// Create and start S3 presign runner
162		s3presignRunner := s3presign.NewRunner(s.Store)
163		s3presignRunner.RunOnce(ctx)
164	
165		// Start continuous S3 presign runner
166		s.backgroundRunnerWG.Add(1)
167		go func() {
168			defer s.backgroundRunnerWG.Done()
169			s3presignRunner.Run(s3Context)
170			slog.Info("s3presign runner stopped")
171		}()
172	
173		slog.Info("background runners started")
174	}

176	func (s *Server) stopBackgroundRunners() {
177		for _, cancelFunc := range s.backgroundRunnerCancels {
178			if cancelFunc != nil {
179				cancelFunc()
180			}
181		}
182	}
183	
184	func (s *Server) waitBackgroundRunners(ctx context.Context) {
185		done := make(chan struct{})
186		go func() {
187			s.backgroundRunnerWG.Wait()
188			close(done)
189		}()
190	
191		select {
192		case <-done:
193		case <-ctx.Done():
194			select {
195			case <-done:
196				return
197			default:
198			}
199			slog.Error("failed to stop background runners", slog.String("error", ctx.Err().Error()))
200		}
201	}

203	func (s *Server) closeLongLivedConnections() {
204		// Long-lived SSE requests do not finish on their own during http.Server.Shutdown.
205		if s.sseHub != nil {

55	func (s *APIV1Service) CreateAttachment(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.CreateAttachmentRequest) (*v1pb.Attachment, error) {
56		user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
57		if err != nil {
58			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get current user: %v", err)
59		}
60		if user == nil {
61			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
62		}
63	
64		// Validate required fields
65		if request.Attachment == nil {
66			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "attachment is required")
67		}
68		if request.Attachment.Filename == "" {
69			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "filename is required")
70		}
71		if !validateFilename(request.Attachment.Filename) {
72			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "filename contains invalid characters or format")
73		}
74		normalizedMimeType := request.Attachment.Type
75		if normalizedMimeType == "" {
76			ext := filepath.Ext(request.Attachment.Filename)
77			mimeType := mime.TypeByExtension(ext)
78			if mimeType == "" {
79				mimeType = http.DetectContentType(request.Attachment.Content)
80			}
81			if normalizedType, ok := normalizeMimeType(mimeType); ok {
82				normalizedMimeType = normalizedType
83			}
84		}
85		if normalizedMimeType == "" {
86			normalizedMimeType = "application/octet-stream"
87		}
88		normalizedType, ok := normalizeMimeType(normalizedMimeType)
89		if !ok {
90			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid MIME type format")
91		}
92		request.Attachment.Type = normalizedType
93	
94		attachmentUID, err := ValidateAndGenerateUID(request.AttachmentId)
95		if err != nil {
96			return nil, err
97		}
98	
99		create := &store.Attachment{
100			UID:       attachmentUID,
101			CreatorID: user.ID,
102			Filename:  request.Attachment.Filename,
103			Type:      request.Attachment.Type,
104		}
105	
106		inputMotionMedia, err := validateClientMotionMedia(request.Attachment.MotionMedia, attachmentUID)
107		if err != nil {
108			return nil, err
109		}
110		if inputMotionMedia != nil {
111			create.Payload = ensureAttachmentPayload(create.Payload)
112			create.Payload.MotionMedia = inputMotionMedia
113		}
114	
115		instanceStorageSetting, err := s.Store.GetInstanceStorageSetting(ctx)
116		if err != nil {
117			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get instance storage setting: %v", err)
118		}
119		size := binary.Size(request.Attachment.Content)
120		uploadSizeLimit := int(instanceStorageSetting.UploadSizeLimitMb) * MebiByte
121		if uploadSizeLimit == 0 {
122			uploadSizeLimit = MaxUploadBufferSizeBytes
123		}
124		if size > uploadSizeLimit {
125			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "file size exceeds the limit")
126		}
127		create.Size = int64(size)
128		create.Blob = request.Attachment.Content
129	
130		if request.Attachment.Memo != nil {
131			memoUID, err := ExtractMemoUIDFromName(*request.Attachment.Memo)
132			if err != nil {
133				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo name: %v", err)
134			}
135			memo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{UID: &memoUID})
136			if err != nil {
137				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to find memo: %v", err)
138			}
139			if memo == nil {
140				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found: %s", *request.Attachment.Memo)
141			}
142			if !canModifyMemo(user, memo) {
143				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
144			}
145			create.MemoID = &memo.ID
146		}
147	
148		if create.Payload == nil || create.Payload.MotionMedia == nil {
149			if detectedMotion := detectAndroidMotionMedia(create.Blob, create.Type, attachmentUID); detectedMotion != nil {
150				create.Payload = ensureAttachmentPayload(create.Payload)
151				create.Payload.MotionMedia = detectedMotion
152			}
153		}
154	
155		// Strip EXIF metadata from images for privacy protection.
156		// This removes sensitive information like GPS location, device details, etc.
157		if shouldStripExif(create.Type) && !isAndroidMotionContainer(create.Payload.GetMotionMedia()) {
158			release, err := s.acquireImageProcessingSlot(ctx)
159			if err != nil {
160				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.ResourceExhausted, "too many image processing requests")
161			}
162			strippedBlob, stripErr := stripImageExif(create.Blob, create.Type)
163			release()
164			if stripErr != nil {
165				// Log warning but continue with original image to ensure uploads don't fail.
166				slog.Warn("failed to strip EXIF metadata from image",
167					slog.String("type", create.Type),
168					slog.String("filename", create.Filename),
169					slog.String("error", stripErr.Error()))
170			} else {
171				create.Blob = strippedBlob
172				create.Size = int64(len(strippedBlob))
173			}
174		}
175	
176		if err := SaveAttachmentBlob(ctx, s.Profile, s.Store, create); err != nil {
177			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to save attachment blob: %v", err)
178		}
179	
180		attachment, err := s.Store.CreateAttachment(ctx, create)
181		if err != nil {
182			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create attachment: %v", err)
183		}
184	
185		return convertAttachmentFromStore(attachment), nil

188	func (s *APIV1Service) ListAttachments(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.ListAttachmentsRequest) (*v1pb.ListAttachmentsResponse, error) {
189		user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)

192		}
193		if user == nil {
194			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
195		}
196	
197		pageSize := normalizePageSize(request.PageSize)
198	
199		// Parse page token for offset
200		offset := 0
201		if request.PageToken != "" {
202			// Simple implementation: page token is the offset as string
203			// In production, you might want to use encrypted tokens
204			if parsed, err := fmt.Sscanf(request.PageToken, "%d", &offset); err != nil || parsed != 1 {
205				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid page token")
206			}
207		}
208	
209		findAttachment := &store.FindAttachment{
210			CreatorID: &user.ID,
211			Limit:     &pageSize,
212			Offset:    &offset,
213		}
214	
215		// Parse filter if provided
216		if request.Filter != "" {
217			if err := s.validateAttachmentFilter(ctx, request.Filter); err != nil {
218				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid filter: %v", err)
219			}
220			findAttachment.Filters = append(findAttachment.Filters, request.Filter)
221		}
222	
223		attachments, err := s.Store.ListAttachments(ctx, findAttachment)
224		if err != nil {
225			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list attachments: %v", err)
226		}
227	
228		response := &v1pb.ListAttachmentsResponse{}
229	
230		for _, attachment := range attachments {
231			response.Attachments = append(response.Attachments, convertAttachmentFromStore(attachment))
232		}
233	
234		// Set next page token if we got the full page size (indicating there might be more)
235		if len(attachments) == pageSize {
236			response.NextPageToken = fmt.Sprintf("%d", offset+pageSize)
237		}
238	
239		return response, nil
240	}

393	func (s *APIV1Service) validateAttachmentFilter(ctx context.Context, filterStr string) error {
394		if filterStr == "" {
395			return errors.New("filter cannot be empty")
396		}
397	
398		engine, err := filter.DefaultAttachmentEngine()
399		if err != nil {
400			return err

402	
403		var dialect filter.DialectName
404		switch s.Profile.Driver {
405		case "mysql":
406			dialect = filter.DialectMySQL
407		case "postgres":
408			dialect = filter.DialectPostgres
409		default:
410			dialect = filter.DialectSQLite
411		}
412	
413		if _, err := engine.CompileToStatement(ctx, filterStr, filter.RenderOptions{Dialect: dialect}); err != nil {
414			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to compile filter")
415		}
416		return nil
417	}

419	// checkAttachmentAccess verifies the user has permission to access the attachment.
420	// For unlinked attachments (no memo), only the creator can access.
421	// For linked attachments, access follows the memo's visibility rules.
422	func (s *APIV1Service) checkAttachmentAccess(ctx context.Context, attachment *store.Attachment) error {
423		user, _ := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
424	
425		// For unlinked attachments, only the creator can access.
426		if attachment.MemoID == nil {
427			if user == nil {
428				return status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
429			}
430			if attachment.CreatorID != user.ID && !isSuperUser(user) {
431				return status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
432			}
433			return nil
434		}
435	
436		// For linked attachments, check memo visibility.
437		memo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{ID: attachment.MemoID})
438		if err != nil {
439			return status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get memo: %v", err)
440		}
441		if memo == nil {
442			return status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
443		}
444	
445		if memo.Visibility == store.Public {
446			return nil
447		}
448		if user == nil {
449			return status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
450		}
451		if memo.Visibility == store.Private && memo.CreatorID != user.ID && !isSuperUser(user) {
452			return status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
453		}
454		return nil

202	func (s *Store) deleteAttachmentStorageImpl(ctx context.Context, attachment *Attachment, instanceStorageSetting *storepb.InstanceStorageSetting) error {
203		if attachment == nil {
204			return nil
205		}
206		if shouldFailDeleteAttachmentStorage(ctx) {
207			return ErrDeleteAttachmentStorageFailpoint
208		}
209	
210		if attachment.StorageType == storepb.AttachmentStorageType_LOCAL {
211			if err := func() error {
212				p := filepath.FromSlash(attachment.Reference)
213				if !filepath.IsAbs(p) {
214					p = filepath.Join(s.profile.Data, p)
215				}
216				err := os.Remove(p)
217				if err != nil && !os.IsNotExist(err) {
218					return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to delete local file")
219				}
220				return nil
221			}(); err != nil {
222				return err
223			}
224		} else if attachment.StorageType == storepb.AttachmentStorageType_S3 {
225			if err := func() error {
226				s3ObjectPayload := attachment.Payload.GetS3Object()
227				if s3ObjectPayload == nil {
228					return errors.Errorf("No s3 object found")
229				}
230				s3Config := s3ObjectPayload.S3Config
231				if s3Config == nil {
232					if instanceStorageSetting == nil {
233						var err error
234						instanceStorageSetting, err = s.GetInstanceStorageSetting(ctx)
235						if err != nil {
236							return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get instance storage setting")
237						}
238					}
239					if instanceStorageSetting.S3Config == nil {
240						return errors.Errorf("S3 config is not found")
241					}
242					s3Config = instanceStorageSetting.S3Config
243				}
244	
245				s3Client, err := s3.NewClient(ctx, s3Config)
246				if err != nil {
247					return errors.Wrap(err, "Failed to create s3 client")
248				}
249				if err := s3Client.DeleteObject(ctx, s3ObjectPayload.Key); err != nil {
250					return errors.Wrap(err, "Failed to delete s3 object")
251				}
252				return nil
253			}(); err != nil {
254				return err
255			}
256		}
257	
258		s.deleteAttachmentDerivedCaches(attachment)
259		return nil
260	}

44	func NewServer(ctx context.Context, profile *profile.Profile, store *store.Store) (*Server, error) {
45		s := &Server{
46			Store:   store,
47			Profile: profile,
48		}
49	
50		echoServer := echo.New()
51		echoServer.Use(middleware.Recover())
52		echoServer.Use(newCORSMiddleware(profile))
53		s.echoServer = echoServer
54	
55		instanceBasicSetting, err := s.getOrUpsertInstanceBasicSetting(ctx)
56		if err != nil {
57			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get instance basic setting")
58		}
59	
60		secret := "usememos"
61		if !profile.Demo {
62			secret = instanceBasicSetting.SecretKey
63		}
64		s.Secret = secret
65	
66		// Register healthz endpoint.
67		echoServer.GET("/healthz", func(c *echo.Context) error {
68			return c.String(http.StatusOK, "Service ready.")
69		})
70	
71		// Serve frontend static files.
72		frontend.NewFrontendService(profile, store).Serve(ctx, echoServer)
73	
74		rootGroup := echoServer.Group("")
75	
76		apiV1Service := apiv1.NewAPIV1Service(s.Secret, profile, store)
77		s.sseHub = apiV1Service.SSEHub
78	
79		// Register HTTP file server routes BEFORE gRPC-Gateway to ensure proper range request handling for Safari.
80		// This uses native HTTP serving (http.ServeContent) instead of gRPC for video/audio files.
81		fileServerService := fileserver.NewFileServerService(s.Profile, s.Store, s.Secret)
82		fileServerService.RegisterRoutes(echoServer)
83	
84		// Create and register RSS routes (needs markdown service from apiV1Service).
85		rss.NewRSSService(s.Profile, s.Store, apiV1Service.MarkdownService).RegisterRoutes(rootGroup)
86	
87		// Register gRPC gateway as api v1 (includes SSE endpoint on CORS-enabled group).
88		if err := apiV1Service.RegisterGateway(ctx, echoServer); err != nil {
89			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to register gRPC gateway")
90		}
91	
92		mcpService, err := mcp.NewMCPService(profile, echoServer)
93		if err != nil {
94			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to create MCP service")
95		}
96		mcpService.RegisterRoutes(echoServer)
97	
98		return s, nil
99	}

101	func (s *Server) Start(ctx context.Context) error {
102		var address, network string
103		if len(s.Profile.UNIXSock) == 0 {
104			address = fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", s.Profile.Addr, s.Profile.Port)
105			network = "tcp"
106		} else {
107			address = s.Profile.UNIXSock
108			network = "unix"
109		}
110		listener, err := net.Listen(network, address)
111		if err != nil {
112			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to listen")
113		}
114	
115		if network == "unix" {
116			if err := os.Chmod(address, 0660); err != nil {
117				_ = listener.Close()
118				return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to chmod socket")
119			}
120		}
121	
122		// Start Echo server directly (no cmux needed - all traffic is HTTP).
123		s.httpServer = &http.Server{Handler: s.echoServer}
124		go func() {
125			if err := s.httpServer.Serve(listener); err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {
126				slog.Error("failed to start echo server", "error", err)
127			}
128		}()
129		s.startBackgroundRunners(ctx)
130	
131		return nil
132	}

134	func (s *Server) Shutdown(ctx context.Context) {
135		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, shutdownTimeout)
136		defer cancel()
137	
138		slog.Info("server shutting down")
139	
140		s.stopBackgroundRunners()
141		s.closeLongLivedConnections()
142		s.shutdownHTTPServer(ctx)
143		s.waitBackgroundRunners(ctx)
144	
145		// Close database connection.
146		if err := s.Store.Close(); err != nil {
147			slog.Error("failed to close database", slog.String("error", err.Error()))
148		}
149	
150		slog.Info("memos stopped properly")
151	}

153	func (s *Server) startBackgroundRunners(ctx context.Context) {
154		// Create a separate context for each background runner
155		// This allows us to control cancellation for each runner independently
156		s3Context, s3Cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
157	
158		// Store the cancel function so we can properly shut down runners
159		s.backgroundRunnerCancels = append(s.backgroundRunnerCancels, s3Cancel)
160	
161		// Create and start S3 presign runner
162		s3presignRunner := s3presign.NewRunner(s.Store)
163		s3presignRunner.RunOnce(ctx)
164	
165		// Start continuous S3 presign runner
166		s.backgroundRunnerWG.Add(1)
167		go func() {
168			defer s.backgroundRunnerWG.Done()
169			s3presignRunner.Run(s3Context)
170			slog.Info("s3presign runner stopped")
171		}()
172	
173		slog.Info("background runners started")
174	}

176	func (s *Server) stopBackgroundRunners() {
177		for _, cancelFunc := range s.backgroundRunnerCancels {
178			if cancelFunc != nil {
179				cancelFunc()
180			}
181		}
182	}

186		fmt.Printf("Database driver: %s\n", profile.Driver)
187	
188		// Connection information
189		if len(profile.UNIXSock) == 0 {
190			if len(profile.Addr) == 0 {
191				fmt.Printf("Server running on port %d\n", profile.Port)
192				fmt.Printf("Access your memos at: http://localhost:%d\n", profile.Port)
193			} else {
194				fmt.Printf("Server running on %s:%d\n", profile.Addr, profile.Port)
195				fmt.Printf("Access your memos at: http://%s:%d\n", profile.Addr, profile.Port)
196			}
197		} else {
198			fmt.Printf("Server running on unix socket: %s\n", profile.UNIXSock)
199		}
200	
201		// Access mode is derived from instance_url: set = public, unset = private.
202		accessMode := "private"
203		if profile.AllowAnonymous() {

53	func (s *APIV1Service) CreateUserWebhook(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.CreateUserWebhookRequest) (*v1pb.UserWebhook, error) {
54		user, err := s.resolveUserFromName(ctx, request.Parent)
55		if err != nil {
56			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid parent: %v", err)
57		}
58		userID := user.ID
59	
60		currentUser, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
61		if err != nil {
62			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get current user: %v", err)
63		}
64		if currentUser == nil {
65			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
66		}
67		if currentUser.ID != userID && currentUser.Role != store.RoleAdmin {
68			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
69		}
70	
71		if request.Webhook.Url == "" {
72			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "webhook URL is required")
73		}
74		if err := webhook.ValidateURL(strings.TrimSpace(request.Webhook.Url)); err != nil {
75			return nil, err
76		}
77		// The signing secret is generated server-side so it always meets the Standard
78		// Webhooks length requirement. A client-supplied secret is still accepted (and
79		// validated) for backward compatibility.
80		signingSecret := strings.TrimSpace(request.Webhook.SigningSecret)
81		if signingSecret == "" {
82			signingSecret, err = webhook.GenerateSigningSecret()
83			if err != nil {
84				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to generate signing secret: %v", err)
85			}
86		} else if err := webhook.ValidateSigningSecret(signingSecret); err != nil {
87			return nil, err
88		}
89	
90		webhookID := generateUserWebhookID()
91		webhook := &storepb.WebhooksUserSetting_Webhook{
92			Id:            webhookID,
93			Title:         request.Webhook.DisplayName,
94			Url:           strings.TrimSpace(request.Webhook.Url),
95			SigningSecret: signingSecret,
96		}
97	
98		err = s.Store.AddUserWebhook(ctx, userID, webhook)
99		if err != nil {
100			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create webhook: %v", err)

102

106	func (s *APIV1Service) UpdateUserWebhook(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.UpdateUserWebhookRequest) (*v1pb.UserWebhook, error) {
107		if request.Webhook == nil {
108			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "webhook is required")
109		}
110	
111		user, webhookID, err := s.resolveUserAndWebhookIDFromName(ctx, request.Webhook.Name)
112		if err != nil {
113			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid webhook name: %v", err)
114		}
115		userID := user.ID
116	
117		currentUser, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
118		if err != nil {
119			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get current user: %v", err)
120		}
121		if currentUser == nil {
122			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
123		}
124		if currentUser.ID != userID && currentUser.Role != store.RoleAdmin {
125			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
126		}
127	
128		// Get existing webhooks
129		webhooks, err := s.Store.GetUserWebhooks(ctx, userID)
130		if err != nil {
131			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user webhooks: %v", err)
132		}
133	
134		// Find the webhook to update
135		var targetWebhook *storepb.WebhooksUserSetting_Webhook
136		for _, webhook := range webhooks {
137			if webhook.Id == webhookID {
138				targetWebhook = webhook
139				break
140			}
141		}
142	
143		if targetWebhook == nil {
144			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "webhook not found")
145		}
146	
147		// Update the webhook
148		updatedWebhook := &storepb.WebhooksUserSetting_Webhook{
149			Id:            webhookID,
150			Title:         targetWebhook.Title,
151			Url:           targetWebhook.Url,
152			SigningSecret: targetWebhook.SigningSecret,
153		}
154	
155		if request.UpdateMask != nil {
156			for _, path := range request.UpdateMask.Paths {
157				switch path {
158				case "url":
159					if request.Webhook.Url != "" {
160						trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(request.Webhook.Url)
161						if err := webhook.ValidateURL(trimmed); err != nil {
162							return nil, err
163						}
164						updatedWebhook.Url = trimmed
165					}
166				case "display_name":
167					updatedWebhook.Title = request.Webhook.DisplayName
168				case "signing_secret":
169					secret := strings.TrimSpace(request.Webhook.SigningSecret)
170					if err := webhook.ValidateSigningSecret(secret); err != nil {
171						return nil, err
172					}
173					updatedWebhook.SigningSecret = secret
174				default:
175					// Ignore unsupported fields
176				}
177			}
178		} else {
179			// If no update mask is provided, update all fields
180			if request.Webhook.Url != "" {
181				trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(request.Webhook.Url)
182				if err := webhook.ValidateURL(trimmed); err != nil {
183					return nil, err
184				}
185				updatedWebhook.Url = trimmed
186			}
187			updatedWebhook.Title = request.Webhook.DisplayName
188			if request.Webhook.SigningSecret != "" {
189				secret := strings.TrimSpace(request.Webhook.SigningSecret)
190				if err := webhook.ValidateSigningSecret(secret); err != nil {
191					return nil, err
192				}
193				updatedWebhook.SigningSecret = secret
194			}
195		}
196	
197		err = s.Store.UpdateUserWebhook(ctx, userID, updatedWebhook)
198		if err != nil {
199			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to update webhook: %v", err)
200		}
201	
202		return convertUserWebhookFromUserSetting(updatedWebhook, user), nil
203	}

51	func secureDialContext(ctx context.Context, network, address string) (net.Conn, error) {
52		host, port, err := net.SplitHostPort(address)
53		if err != nil {
54			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "invalid address")
55		}
56	
57		ips, err := resolveAllowedIPs(ctx, host)
58		if err != nil {
59			return nil, err
60		}
61	
62		var dialErr error
63		for _, ip := range ips {
64			conn, err := dialContext(ctx, network, net.JoinHostPort(ip.String(), port))
65			if err == nil {
66				return conn, nil
67			}
68			dialErr = err
69		}
70		return nil, dialErr
71	}

74		if ip := net.ParseIP(host); ip != nil {
75			if isInternalIP(ip) {

77			}
78			return []net.IP{ip}, nil
79		}

81		addrs, err := lookupIPAddr(ctx, host)
82		if err != nil {
83			return nil, errors.Errorf("failed to resolve hostname: %v", err)
84		}

86		ips := make([]net.IP, 0, len(addrs))
87		for _, addr := range addrs {

92			if isInternalIP(ip) {
93				return nil, errors.Wrapf(ErrInternalIP, "host=%s, ip=%s", host, ip.String())
94			}
95			ips = append(ips, ip)
96		}
97		if len(ips) == 0 {
98			return nil, errors.New("hostname resolved to no addresses")
99		}
100	
101		return ips, nil
102	}

86	// TestPostSignsRequest verifies the end-to-end Standard Webhooks signature so a
87	// receiver following the documented verification recipe will accept our requests.
88	func TestPostSignsRequest(t *testing.T) {
89		// httptest listens on 127.0.0.1, which the SSRF guard blocks by default.
90		prev := AllowPrivateIPs
91		AllowPrivateIPs = true
92		defer func() { AllowPrivateIPs = prev }()
93	
94		rawKey := []byte("0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef")
95		cases := []struct {
96			name   string
97			secret string
98			key    []byte
99		}{
100			{name: "plain secret", secret: "plain-secret-value", key: []byte("plain-secret-value")},
101			{name: "whsec_ secret", secret: "whsec_" + base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(rawKey), key: rawKey},
102		}
103	
104		for _, tc := range cases {
105			t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
106				var gotID, gotTimestamp, gotSignature string
107				var gotBody []byte
108				server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
109					gotID = r.Header.Get("webhook-id")
110					gotTimestamp = r.Header.Get("webhook-timestamp")
111					gotSignature = r.Header.Get("webhook-signature")
112					gotBody, _ = io.ReadAll(r.Body)
113					_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"code":0}`))
114				}))
115				defer server.Close()
116	
117				err := Post(&WebhookRequestPayload{
118					URL:           server.URL,
119					ActivityType:  "memos.memo.created",
120					Creator:       "users/1",
121					SigningSecret: tc.secret,
122				})
123				require.NoError(t, err)
124	
125				require.True(t, strings.HasPrefix(gotID, "msg_"), "webhook-id should be prefixed with msg_")
126				require.NotEmpty(t, gotTimestamp)
127				require.True(t, strings.HasPrefix(gotSignature, "v1,"), "signature should carry the v1 version tag")
128	
129				// Recompute the signature the way a receiver would and confirm it matches.
130				mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, tc.key)
131				mac.Write([]byte(gotID + "." + gotTimestamp + "."))
132				mac.Write(gotBody)
133				want := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
134				require.Equal(t, "v1,"+want, gotSignature)
135			})
136		}
137	}

2	
3	## Supported Versions
4	
5	Memos is currently a `0.x` project. Security fixes are only provided for the latest release. Older releases are not supported for security updates, and fixes are not backported.
6	
7	If you run Memos in production, keep your instance updated to the latest release.
8	
9	## Reporting a Vulnerability
10	
11	Please report security issues privately by email: `dev@usememos.com`
12	
13	Do not open public GitHub issues, discussions, or pull requests for suspected vulnerabilities.
14	
15	Please include:
16	
17	- A clear description of the issue
18	- Steps to reproduce
19	- Affected version or commit
20	- Deployment details that matter to reproduction
21	- Your assessment of impact
22	
23	We will review reports as time permits and fix valid issues in regular releases.
24	
25	## Disclosure and CVEs
26	
27	Memos is self-hosted software and is still in the `0.x` stage. At this stage, we do not run a formal disclosure program, publish separate security advisories for every issue, or request CVE IDs.
28	
29	Security fixes may be shipped directly in normal releases or noted briefly in release notes and changelogs.
30	
31	## Self-Hosted Deployment Notes
32	
33	The security posture of a Memos instance depends heavily on how it is deployed and operated. In particular:
34	
35	- Keep Memos updated
36	- Put it behind a properly configured reverse proxy when exposed to the internet
37	- Require authentication for any non-public deployment
38	- Use TLS in production
39	- Limit access to trusted users and administrators
40	
41	Reports that depend entirely on intentionally unsafe deployment choices, unsupported local patches, or administrator actions may be treated as deployment issues rather than product vulnerabilities.

104	func (s *APIV1Service) resolveSSOIdentity(ctx context.Context, idpName, code, redirectURI, codeVerifier string) (*storepb.IdentityProvider, *idp.IdentityProviderUserInfo, error) {
105		idpUID, err := ExtractIdentityProviderUIDFromName(idpName)
106		if err != nil {
107			return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid identity provider name: %v", err)
108		}
109		identityProvider, err := s.Store.GetIdentityProvider(ctx, &store.FindIdentityProvider{
110			UID: &idpUID,
111		})
112		if err != nil {
113			return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get identity provider, error: %v", err)
114		}
115		if identityProvider == nil {
116			return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "identity provider not found")
117		}
118	
119		var userInfo *idp.IdentityProviderUserInfo
120		if identityProvider.Type == storepb.IdentityProvider_OAUTH2 {
121			oauth2IdentityProvider, err := oauth2.NewIdentityProvider(identityProvider.Config.GetOauth2Config())
122			if err != nil {
123				return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create oauth2 identity provider, error: %v", err)
124			}
125			// Pass code_verifier for PKCE support (empty string if not provided for backward compatibility)
126			token, err := oauth2IdentityProvider.ExchangeToken(ctx, redirectURI, code, codeVerifier)
127			if err != nil {
128				return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to exchange token, error: %v", err)
129			}
130			userInfo, err = oauth2IdentityProvider.UserInfo(ctx, token)
131			if err != nil {
132				return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user info, error: %v", err)
133			}
134		}
135	
136		identifierFilter := identityProvider.IdentifierFilter
137		if identifierFilter != "" {
138			identifierFilterRegex, err := regexp.Compile(identifierFilter)
139			if err != nil {
140				return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to compile identifier filter regex, error: %v", err)
141			}
142			if !identifierFilterRegex.MatchString(userInfo.Identifier) {
143				return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "identifier %s is not allowed", userInfo.Identifier)
144			}
145		}
146	
147		return identityProvider, userInfo, nil
148	}

224	// isUniqueConstraintViolation matches the driver-specific error messages that each
225	// supported backend emits when any UNIQUE constraint rejects an insert. Callers
226	// disambiguate which constraint was hit from the insertion context (e.g. inserting
227	// a user_identity row can only violate UNIQUE(provider, extern_uid); inserting a
228	// user row can only violate UNIQUE(username)). Matches the pattern used in
229	// memo_service.go for the memo UID unique check.
230	func isUniqueConstraintViolation(err error) bool {
231		if err == nil {
232			return false
233		}
234		msg := err.Error()
235		return strings.Contains(msg, "UNIQUE constraint failed") ||
236			strings.Contains(msg, "duplicate key") ||
237			strings.Contains(msg, "Duplicate entry")
238	}

174	
175		tests := []struct {
176			name             string
177			acceptBasicAuth  bool
178			expectedRequests int
179		}{
180			{
181				name:             "client secret basic",
182				acceptBasicAuth:  true,
183				expectedRequests: 1,
184			},
185			{
186				name:             "client secret post fallback",
187				acceptBasicAuth:  false,
188				expectedRequests: 2,
189			},
190		}
191	
192		for _, test := range tests {
193			t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
194				requestCount := 0
195				server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
196					requestCount++
197					require.NoError(t, r.ParseForm())
198					require.Equal(t, code, r.Form.Get("code"))
199					require.Equal(t, codeVerifier, r.Form.Get("code_verifier"))
200	
201					username, password, hasBasicAuth := r.BasicAuth()
202					if test.acceptBasicAuth {
203						require.True(t, hasBasicAuth)
204						require.Equal(t, clientID, username)
205						require.Equal(t, clientSecret, password)
206						require.Empty(t, r.Form.Get("client_id"))
207						require.Empty(t, r.Form.Get("client_secret"))
208					} else if hasBasicAuth {
209						http.Error(w, `{"error":"invalid_client"}`, http.StatusUnauthorized)
210						return
211					} else {
212						require.Equal(t, clientID, r.Form.Get("client_id"))
213						require.Equal(t, clientSecret, r.Form.Get("client_secret"))
214					}
215	
216					w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")

218						"access_token": accessToken,
219						"token_type":   "Bearer",
220					}))
221				}))

224				provider, err := NewIdentityProvider(&storepb.OAuth2Config{

227					TokenUrl:     server.URL,

230				})

102		}

104		// Look up the IdP by UID to get the internal ID for update.
105		existing, err := s.Store.GetStoredIdentityProvider(ctx, &store.FindIdentityProvider{UID: &uid})

104	func (s *APIV1Service) resolveSSOIdentity(ctx context.Context, idpName, code, redirectURI, codeVerifier string) (*storepb.IdentityProvider, *idp.IdentityProviderUserInfo, error) {
105		idpUID, err := ExtractIdentityProviderUIDFromName(idpName)
106		if err != nil {
107			return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid identity provider name: %v", err)
108		}
109		identityProvider, err := s.Store.GetIdentityProvider(ctx, &store.FindIdentityProvider{
110			UID: &idpUID,
111		})
112		if err != nil {
113			return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get identity provider, error: %v", err)
114		}
115		if identityProvider == nil {
116			return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "identity provider not found")
117		}
118	
119		var userInfo *idp.IdentityProviderUserInfo
120		if identityProvider.Type == storepb.IdentityProvider_OAUTH2 {
121			oauth2IdentityProvider, err := oauth2.NewIdentityProvider(identityProvider.Config.GetOauth2Config())
122			if err != nil {
123				return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create oauth2 identity provider, error: %v", err)
124			}
125			// Pass code_verifier for PKCE support (empty string if not provided for backward compatibility)
126			token, err := oauth2IdentityProvider.ExchangeToken(ctx, redirectURI, code, codeVerifier)
127			if err != nil {
128				return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to exchange token, error: %v", err)
129			}
130			userInfo, err = oauth2IdentityProvider.UserInfo(ctx, token)
131			if err != nil {
132				return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user info, error: %v", err)
133			}
134		}
135	
136		identifierFilter := identityProvider.IdentifierFilter
137		if identifierFilter != "" {
138			identifierFilterRegex, err := regexp.Compile(identifierFilter)
139			if err != nil {
140				return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to compile identifier filter regex, error: %v", err)
141			}
142			if !identifierFilterRegex.MatchString(userInfo.Identifier) {
143				return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "identifier %s is not allowed", userInfo.Identifier)
144			}
145		}
146	
147		return identityProvider, userInfo, nil
148	}

224	// isUniqueConstraintViolation matches the driver-specific error messages that each
225	// supported backend emits when any UNIQUE constraint rejects an insert. Callers
226	// disambiguate which constraint was hit from the insertion context (e.g. inserting
227	// a user_identity row can only violate UNIQUE(provider, extern_uid); inserting a
228	// user row can only violate UNIQUE(username)). Matches the pattern used in
229	// memo_service.go for the memo UID unique check.
230	func isUniqueConstraintViolation(err error) bool {
231		if err == nil {
232			return false
233		}
234		msg := err.Error()
235		return strings.Contains(msg, "UNIQUE constraint failed") ||
236			strings.Contains(msg, "duplicate key") ||
237			strings.Contains(msg, "Duplicate entry")
238	}

174	
175		tests := []struct {
176			name             string
177			acceptBasicAuth  bool
178			expectedRequests int
179		}{
180			{
181				name:             "client secret basic",
182				acceptBasicAuth:  true,
183				expectedRequests: 1,
184			},
185			{
186				name:             "client secret post fallback",
187				acceptBasicAuth:  false,
188				expectedRequests: 2,
189			},
190		}
191	
192		for _, test := range tests {
193			t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
194				requestCount := 0
195				server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
196					requestCount++
197					require.NoError(t, r.ParseForm())
198					require.Equal(t, code, r.Form.Get("code"))
199					require.Equal(t, codeVerifier, r.Form.Get("code_verifier"))
200	
201					username, password, hasBasicAuth := r.BasicAuth()
202					if test.acceptBasicAuth {
203						require.True(t, hasBasicAuth)
204						require.Equal(t, clientID, username)
205						require.Equal(t, clientSecret, password)
206						require.Empty(t, r.Form.Get("client_id"))
207						require.Empty(t, r.Form.Get("client_secret"))
208					} else if hasBasicAuth {
209						http.Error(w, `{"error":"invalid_client"}`, http.StatusUnauthorized)
210						return
211					} else {
212						require.Equal(t, clientID, r.Form.Get("client_id"))
213						require.Equal(t, clientSecret, r.Form.Get("client_secret"))
214					}
215	
216					w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")

218						"access_token": accessToken,
219						"token_type":   "Bearer",
220					}))
221				}))

224				provider, err := NewIdentityProvider(&storepb.OAuth2Config{

227					TokenUrl:     server.URL,

230				})

102		}

104		// Look up the IdP by UID to get the internal ID for update.
105		existing, err := s.Store.GetStoredIdentityProvider(ctx, &store.FindIdentityProvider{UID: &uid})

196			}
197		} else {
198			fmt.Printf("Server running on unix socket: %s\n", profile.UNIXSock)
199		}
200	
201		// Access mode is derived from instance_url: set = public, unset = private.

159	// waitForDB polls the database until it's ready or timeout is reached.
160	func waitForDB(driver, dsn string, timeout time.Duration) error {
161		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), timeout)
162		defer cancel()
163	
164		ticker := time.NewTicker(500 * time.Millisecond)
165		defer ticker.Stop()
166	
167		var lastErr error
168		for {
169			select {
170			case <-ctx.Done():
171				if lastErr != nil {
172					return errors.Errorf("timeout waiting for %s database: %v", driver, lastErr)
173				}
174				return errors.Errorf("timeout waiting for %s database to be ready", driver)
175			case <-ticker.C:
176				db, err := sql.Open(driver, dsn)
177				if err != nil {
178					lastErr = err
179					continue
180				}
181				err = db.PingContext(ctx)
182				db.Close()
183				if err == nil {
184					return nil
185				}
186				lastErr = err
187			}
188		}
189	}

32			return nil, errors.New("Parse DSN error")
33		}

35		driver.db, err = sql.Open("mysql", dsn)

159	// waitForDB polls the database until it's ready or timeout is reached.
160	func waitForDB(driver, dsn string, timeout time.Duration) error {
161		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), timeout)
162		defer cancel()
163	
164		ticker := time.NewTicker(500 * time.Millisecond)
165		defer ticker.Stop()
166	
167		var lastErr error
168		for {
169			select {
170			case <-ctx.Done():
171				if lastErr != nil {
172					return errors.Errorf("timeout waiting for %s database: %v", driver, lastErr)
173				}
174				return errors.Errorf("timeout waiting for %s database to be ready", driver)
175			case <-ticker.C:
176				db, err := sql.Open(driver, dsn)
177				if err != nil {
178					lastErr = err
179					continue
180				}
181				err = db.PingContext(ctx)
182				db.Close()
183				if err == nil {
184					return nil
185				}
186				lastErr = err
187			}
188		}
189	}

290	func StartMemosContainer(ctx context.Context, cfg MemosContainerConfig) (testcontainers.Container, error) {
291		env := map[string]string{

298		}

300		var opts []testcontainers.ContainerCustomizer
301	
302		switch cfg.Driver {
303		case "sqlite":
304			env["MEMOS_DRIVER"] = "sqlite"
305			opts = append(opts, testcontainers.WithHostConfigModifier(func(hc *container.HostConfig) {
306				hc.Binds = append(hc.Binds, fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s", cfg.DataDir, "/var/opt/memos"))
307			}))
308		case "mysql", "postgres":
309			if cfg.DSN == "" {
310				return nil, errors.Errorf("dsn is required for %s migration testing", cfg.Driver)
311			}
312			env["MEMOS_DRIVER"] = cfg.Driver
313			env["MEMOS_DSN"] = cfg.DSN
314		default:
315			return nil, errors.Errorf("unsupported driver for migration testing: %s", cfg.Driver)
316		}
317	
318		req := testcontainers.ContainerRequest{
319			Image:        fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s", MemosDockerImage, cfg.Version),
320			Env:          env,
321			ExposedPorts: []string{"5230/tcp"},
322			WaitingFor:   MemosStartupWaitStrategy,
323			User:         fmt.Sprintf("%d:%d", os.Getuid(), os.Getgid()),
324		}
325	
326		// Use local image if specified
327		if cfg.Version == "local" {
328			if os.Getenv("MEMOS_TEST_IMAGE_BUILT") == "1" {
329				req.Image = "memos-test:local"
330			} else {
331				req.Image = ""
332				req.FromDockerfile = testcontainers.FromDockerfile{
333					Context:    "../../",
334					Dockerfile: "scripts/Dockerfile",
335				}
336			}
337		}
338	
339		genericReq := testcontainers.GenericContainerRequest{
340			ContainerRequest: req,
341			Started:          true,
342		}
343	
344		// Apply options
345		opts = append(opts, network.WithNetwork(nil, nw))
346		for _, opt := range opts {
347			if err := opt.Customize(&genericReq); err != nil {
348				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to apply container option")
349			}
350		}
351	
352		ctr, err := testcontainers.GenericContainer(ctx, genericReq)
353		if err != nil {
354			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to start memos container")
355		}
356	
357		return ctr, nil
358	}

19	// CreateMemoComment creates a comment on an existing memo.
20	func (s *APIV1Service) CreateMemoComment(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.CreateMemoCommentRequest) (*v1pb.Memo, error) {
21		memoUID, err := ExtractMemoUIDFromName(request.Name)
22		if err != nil {
23			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo name: %v", err)
24		}
25		relatedMemo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{UID: &memoUID})
26		if err != nil {
27			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get memo")
28		}
29		if relatedMemo == nil {
30			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
31		}
32	
33		// Check memo visibility before allowing comment.
34		user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
35		if err != nil {
36			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")
37		}
38		if user == nil {
39			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
40		}
41		if relatedMemo.Visibility == store.Private && relatedMemo.CreatorID != user.ID && !isSuperUser(user) {
42			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
43		}
44		if request.Comment == nil {
45			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "comment is required")
46		}
47	
48		comment, ok := proto.Clone(request.Comment).(*v1pb.Memo)
49		if !ok {
50			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to clone memo comment")
51		}
52		comment.Visibility = convertVisibilityFromStore(relatedMemo.Visibility)
53	
54		// Create the memo comment first; suppress the generic memo.created SSE event
55		// since CreateMemoComment broadcasts memo.comment.created for the parent instead.
56		memoComment, err := s.CreateMemo(withSuppressMentionNotifications(withSuppressSSE(ctx)), &v1pb.CreateMemoRequest{
57			Memo:   comment,
58			MemoId: request.CommentId,
59		})
60		if err != nil {
61			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create memo")
62		}
63		memoUID, err = ExtractMemoUIDFromName(memoComment.Name)
64		if err != nil {
65			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo name: %v", err)
66		}
67		memo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{UID: &memoUID})
68		if err != nil {
69			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get memo")
70		}
71	
72		// Build the relation between the comment memo and the original memo.
73		_, err = s.Store.UpsertMemoRelation(ctx, &store.MemoRelation{
74			MemoID:        memo.ID,
75			RelatedMemoID: relatedMemo.ID,
76			Type:          store.MemoRelationComment,
77		})
78		if err != nil {
79			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create memo relation")
80		}
81	
82		// The comment memo was converted before the relation above existed, so its
83		// Relations slice is empty. Reload the relations now so that both the API
84		// response and the memo.comment.created webhook payload carry the relation
85		// to the parent memo.
86		relations, err := s.loadMemoRelations(ctx, memo)
87		if err != nil {
88			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to load memo relations")
89		}
90		memoComment.Relations = relations
91	
92		creator, err := ResolveUserByName(ctx, s.Store, memoComment.Creator)
93		if err != nil {
94			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo creator")
95		}
96		if creator == nil {
97			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo creator not found")
98		}
99		creatorID := creator.ID
100		if memoComment.Visibility != v1pb.Visibility_PRIVATE && creatorID != relatedMemo.CreatorID {
101			if _, err := s.createInboxWithEmailNotification(ctx, &store.Inbox{
102				SenderID:   creatorID,
103				ReceiverID: relatedMemo.CreatorID,
104				Status:     store.UNREAD,
105				Message: &storepb.InboxMessage{
106					Type: storepb.InboxMessage_MEMO_COMMENT,
107					Payload: &storepb.InboxMessage_MemoComment{
108						MemoComment: &storepb.InboxMessage_MemoCommentPayload{
109							MemoId:        memo.ID,
110							RelatedMemoId: relatedMemo.ID,
111						},
112					},
113				},
114			}); err != nil {
115				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create inbox")
116			}
117		}
118	
119		if err := s.DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook(ctx, memoComment, relatedMemo.CreatorID); err != nil {
120			slog.Warn("Failed to dispatch memo comment created webhook", slog.Any("err", err))
121		}
122	
123		s.dispatchMemoMentionNotificationsBestEffort(ctx, memo, relatedMemo, "")
124	
125		// Broadcast live refresh event for the parent memo so subscribers see the new comment.
126		s.SSEHub.Broadcast(&SSEEvent{
127			Type:       SSEEventMemoCommentCreated,
128			Name:       request.Name,
129			Visibility: relatedMemo.Visibility,
130			CreatorID:  relatedMemo.CreatorID,
131		})
132	
133		return memoComment, nil
134	}

136	func (s *APIV1Service) ListMemoComments(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.ListMemoCommentsRequest) (*v1pb.ListMemoCommentsResponse, error) {
137		memoUID, err := ExtractMemoUIDFromName(request.Name)
138		if err != nil {
139			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo name: %v", err)
140		}
141		memo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{UID: &memoUID})
142		if err != nil {
143			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get memo")
144		}
145		if memo == nil {
146			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
147		}
148		if err := s.checkMemoReadAccess(ctx, memo); err != nil {
149			return nil, err
150		}
151	
152		currentUser, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
153		if err != nil {
154			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")
155		}
156		var memoFilter string
157		if currentUser == nil {
158			memoFilter = `visibility == "PUBLIC"`
159		} else {
160			memoFilter = fmt.Sprintf(`creator_id == %d || visibility in ["PUBLIC", "PROTECTED"]`, currentUser.ID)
161		}
162		memoRelationComment := store.MemoRelationComment
163		var limit, offset int
164		if request.PageToken != "" {
165			var pageToken v1pb.PageToken
166			if err := unmarshalPageToken(request.PageToken, &pageToken); err != nil {
167				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid page token: %v", err)
168			}
169			limit = normalizePageSize(pageToken.Limit)
170			offset = max(int(pageToken.Offset), 0)
171		} else {
172			limit = normalizePageSize(request.PageSize)
173		}
174		limitPlusOne := limit + 1
175		memoRelations, err := s.Store.ListMemoRelations(ctx, &store.FindMemoRelation{
176			RelatedMemoID: &memo.ID,
177			Type:          &memoRelationComment,
178			MemoFilter:    &memoFilter,
179			Limit:         &limitPlusOne,
180			Offset:        &offset,
181		})
182		if err != nil {
183			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list memo relations")
184		}
185	
186		nextPageToken := ""
187		if len(memoRelations) == limitPlusOne {
188			memoRelations = memoRelations[:limit]
189			nextPageToken, err = getPageToken(limit, offset+limit)
190			if err != nil {
191				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get next page token, error: %v", err)
192			}
193		}
194	
195		if len(memoRelations) == 0 {
196			response := &v1pb.ListMemoCommentsResponse{
197				Memos:         []*v1pb.Memo{},
198				NextPageToken: nextPageToken,
199			}
200			return response, nil
201		}
202	
203		memoRelationIDs := make([]int32, 0, len(memoRelations))
204		for _, m := range memoRelations {
205			memoRelationIDs = append(memoRelationIDs, m.MemoID)
206		}
207		memos, err := s.Store.ListMemos(ctx, &store.FindMemo{IDList: memoRelationIDs})
208		if err != nil {
209			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list memos")
210		}
211	
212		memoIDToNameMap := make(map[int32]string)
213		contentIDs := make([]string, 0, len(memos))
214		memoIDsForAttachments := make([]int32, 0, len(memos))
215	
216		for _, memo := range memos {
217			memoName := fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", MemoNamePrefix, memo.UID)
218			memoIDToNameMap[memo.ID] = memoName
219			contentIDs = append(contentIDs, memoName)
220			memoIDsForAttachments = append(memoIDsForAttachments, memo.ID)
221		}
222		reactions, err := s.Store.ListReactions(ctx, &store.FindReaction{ContentIDList: contentIDs})
223		if err != nil {
224			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list reactions")
225		}
226	
227		memoReactionsMap := make(map[string][]*store.Reaction)
228		for _, reaction := range reactions {
229			memoReactionsMap[reaction.ContentID] = append(memoReactionsMap[reaction.ContentID], reaction)
230		}
231	
232		attachments, err := s.Store.ListAttachments(ctx, &store.FindAttachment{MemoIDList: memoIDsForAttachments})
233		if err != nil {
234			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list attachments")
235		}
236		attachmentMap := make(map[int32][]*store.Attachment)
237		for _, attachment := range attachments {
238			attachmentMap[*attachment.MemoID] = append(attachmentMap[*attachment.MemoID], attachment)
239		}
240	
241		// RELATIONS (batch load to avoid N+1)
242		relationMap, err := s.batchConvertMemoRelations(ctx, memos, false)
243		if err != nil {
244			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to batch load memo relations")
245		}
246		creatorIDs := make([]int32, 0, len(memos)+len(reactions))
247		for _, memo := range memos {
248			creatorIDs = append(creatorIDs, memo.CreatorID)
249		}
250		for _, reaction := range reactions {
251			creatorIDs = append(creatorIDs, reaction.CreatorID)
252		}
253		creatorMap, err := s.listUsersByID(ctx, creatorIDs)
254		if err != nil {
255			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list memo creators: %v", err)
256		}
257		var memosResponse []*v1pb.Memo
258		for _, m := range memos {
259			memoName := memoIDToNameMap[m.ID]
260			reactions := memoReactionsMap[memoName]
261			attachments := attachmentMap[m.ID]
262			relations := relationMap[m.ID]
263	
264			memoMessage, err := s.convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators(ctx, m, reactions, attachments, relations, creatorMap)
265			if err != nil {
266				if stderrors.Is(err, errMemoCreatorNotFound) {
267					slog.Warn("Skipping memo comment with missing creator",
268						slog.Int64("memo_id", int64(m.ID)),
269						slog.String("memo_uid", m.UID),
270						slog.Int64("creator_id", int64(m.CreatorID)),
271						slog.String("parent_name", request.Name),
272					)
273					continue
274				}
275				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to convert memo")
276			}
277			memosResponse = append(memosResponse, memoMessage)
278		}
279	
280		response := &v1pb.ListMemoCommentsResponse{
281			Memos:         memosResponse,
282			NextPageToken: nextPageToken,
283		}
284		return response, nil
285	}

57	// safeDialContext is a net.Dialer.DialContext replacement that resolves the target
58	// hostname and rejects any address that falls within a reserved/private IP range.
59	func safeDialContext(ctx context.Context, network, addr string) (net.Conn, error) {
60		host, port, err := net.SplitHostPort(addr)
61		if err != nil {
62			return nil, errors.Errorf("webhook: invalid address %q", addr)
63		}
64	
65		ips, err := net.DefaultResolver.LookupHost(ctx, host)
66		if err != nil {
67			return nil, errors.Wrapf(err, "webhook: failed to resolve host %q", host)
68		}
69	
70		for _, ipStr := range ips {
71			if ip := net.ParseIP(ipStr); ip != nil && isReservedIP(ip) {
72				return nil, errors.Errorf("webhook: connection to reserved/private IP address is not allowed")
73			}
74		}
75	
76		return (&net.Dialer{}).DialContext(ctx, network, net.JoinHostPort(host, port))
77	}

92	// resolveSigningKey returns the raw HMAC key for a signing secret. Secrets using
93	// the Standard Webhooks "whsec_<base64>" serialization are base64-decoded to their
94	// raw bytes; any other secret is used as-is. It returns an error when a whsec_-prefixed
95	// secret is not valid base64, so callers fail loudly instead of silently signing with
96	// the wrong key (which would make every signature unverifiable by the receiver).
97	func resolveSigningKey(secret string) ([]byte, error) {
98		if rest, ok := strings.CutPrefix(secret, "whsec_"); ok {
99			decoded, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(rest)
100			if err != nil {
101				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "signing secret has whsec_ prefix but is not valid base64")
102			}
103			return decoded, nil
104		}
105		return []byte(secret), nil
106	}

108	// GenerateSigningSecret returns a new Standard Webhooks signing secret in the
109	// "whsec_<base64>" form, backed by 32 cryptographically-random bytes — comfortably
110	// within the spec's 24–64 byte range.
111	func GenerateSigningSecret() (string, error) {
112		buf := make([]byte, 32)
113		if _, err := rand.Read(buf); err != nil {
114			return "", errors.Wrap(err, "failed to read random bytes for signing secret")
115		}
116		return "whsec_" + base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(buf), nil

119	// Post posts the message to webhook endpoint.

126		req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", requestPayload.URL, bytes.NewBuffer(body))
127		if err != nil {
128			return errors.Wrapf(err, "failed to construct webhook request to %s", requestPayload.URL)
129		}

131		req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
132	
133		if requestPayload.SigningSecret != "" {
134			key, err := resolveSigningKey(requestPayload.SigningSecret)
135			if err != nil {

137			}

139			msgID := "msg_" + uuid.New().String()
140			timestamp := strconv.FormatInt(time.Now().Unix(), 10)

142			mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, key)
143			mac.Write([]byte(msgID + "." + timestamp + "."))
144			mac.Write(body)

147			req.Header.Set("webhook-id", msgID)

193				return &v1pb.ListMemosResponse{}, nil
194			}
195			memoFind.CreatorID = &currentUser.ID
196		} else {
197			state := store.Normal

199		}

202		if request.OrderBy != "" {

209		}

211		if request.Filter != "" {

214			}
215			memoFind.Filters = append(memoFind.Filters, request.Filter)
216		}

218		if currentUser == nil {
219			memoFind.VisibilityList = []store.Visibility{store.Public}

221			if memoFind.CreatorID == nil {
222				filter := fmt.Sprintf(`creator_id == %d || visibility in ["PUBLIC", "PROTECTED"]`, currentUser.ID)
223				memoFind.Filters = append(memoFind.Filters, filter)

227		}

229		var limit, offset int

231			var pageToken v1pb.PageToken

241		limitPlusOne := limit + 1

247		}
248	
249		memoMessages := []*v1pb.Memo{}
250		nextPageToken := ""
251		if len(memos) == limitPlusOne {
252			memos = memos[:limit]
253			nextPageToken, err = getPageToken(limit, offset+limit)
254			if err != nil {
255				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get next page token, error: %v", err)
256			}
257		}
258	
259		if len(memos) == 0 {
260			response := &v1pb.ListMemosResponse{

266	
267		reactionMap := make(map[string][]*store.Reaction)
268		contentIDs := make([]string, 0, len(memos))
269	
270		attachmentMap := make(map[int32][]*store.Attachment)
271		memoIDs := make([]int32, 0, len(memos))

436			if path == "content" {

439				contentLengthLimit, err := s.getContentLengthLimit(ctx)

452			} else if path == "visibility" {

465			} else if path == "pinned" {

467			} else if path == "state" {
468				rowStatus := convertStateToStore(request.Memo.State)

470			} else if path == "create_time" {
471				createdTs := request.Memo.CreateTime.AsTime().Unix()
472				update.CreatedTs = &createdTs
473			} else if path == "update_time" {
474				updatedTs := time.Now().Unix()
475				if request.Memo.UpdateTime != nil {
476					updatedTs = request.Memo.UpdateTime.AsTime().Unix()
477				}
478				update.UpdatedTs = &updatedTs
479			} else if path == "display_time" {
480				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "display_time is not supported")
481			} else if path == "location" {
482				payload := memo.Payload
483				payload.Location = convertLocationToStore(request.Memo.Location)
484				update.Payload = payload
485			} else if path == "attachments" {
486				if err := s.setMemoAttachmentsInternal(ctx, user, memo, request.Memo.Attachments); err != nil {
487					return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to set memo attachments")
488				}
489			} else if path == "relations" {
490				if err := s.setMemoRelationsInternal(ctx, memo, request.Memo.Relations); err != nil {
491					return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to set memo relations")
492				}
493			}
494		}
495	
496		if err = s.Store.UpdateMemo(ctx, update); err != nil {
497			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to update memo")
498		}
499	
500		memo, err = s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{
501			ID: &memo.ID,

504			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get memo")

19	// CreateMemoComment creates a comment on an existing memo.
20	func (s *APIV1Service) CreateMemoComment(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.CreateMemoCommentRequest) (*v1pb.Memo, error) {
21		memoUID, err := ExtractMemoUIDFromName(request.Name)
22		if err != nil {
23			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo name: %v", err)
24		}
25		relatedMemo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{UID: &memoUID})
26		if err != nil {
27			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get memo")
28		}
29		if relatedMemo == nil {
30			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
31		}
32	
33		// Check memo visibility before allowing comment.
34		user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
35		if err != nil {
36			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")
37		}
38		if user == nil {
39			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
40		}
41		if relatedMemo.Visibility == store.Private && relatedMemo.CreatorID != user.ID && !isSuperUser(user) {
42			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
43		}
44		if request.Comment == nil {
45			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "comment is required")
46		}
47	
48		comment, ok := proto.Clone(request.Comment).(*v1pb.Memo)
49		if !ok {
50			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to clone memo comment")
51		}
52		comment.Visibility = convertVisibilityFromStore(relatedMemo.Visibility)
53	
54		// Create the memo comment first; suppress the generic memo.created SSE event
55		// since CreateMemoComment broadcasts memo.comment.created for the parent instead.
56		memoComment, err := s.CreateMemo(withSuppressMentionNotifications(withSuppressSSE(ctx)), &v1pb.CreateMemoRequest{
57			Memo:   comment,
58			MemoId: request.CommentId,
59		})
60		if err != nil {
61			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create memo")
62		}
63		memoUID, err = ExtractMemoUIDFromName(memoComment.Name)
64		if err != nil {
65			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo name: %v", err)
66		}
67		memo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{UID: &memoUID})
68		if err != nil {
69			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get memo")
70		}
71	
72		// Build the relation between the comment memo and the original memo.
73		_, err = s.Store.UpsertMemoRelation(ctx, &store.MemoRelation{
74			MemoID:        memo.ID,
75			RelatedMemoID: relatedMemo.ID,
76			Type:          store.MemoRelationComment,
77		})
78		if err != nil {
79			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create memo relation")
80		}
81	
82		// The comment memo was converted before the relation above existed, so its
83		// Relations slice is empty. Reload the relations now so that both the API
84		// response and the memo.comment.created webhook payload carry the relation
85		// to the parent memo.
86		relations, err := s.loadMemoRelations(ctx, memo)
87		if err != nil {
88			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to load memo relations")
89		}
90		memoComment.Relations = relations
91	
92		creator, err := ResolveUserByName(ctx, s.Store, memoComment.Creator)
93		if err != nil {
94			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo creator")
95		}
96		if creator == nil {
97			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo creator not found")
98		}
99		creatorID := creator.ID
100		if memoComment.Visibility != v1pb.Visibility_PRIVATE && creatorID != relatedMemo.CreatorID {
101			if _, err := s.createInboxWithEmailNotification(ctx, &store.Inbox{
102				SenderID:   creatorID,
103				ReceiverID: relatedMemo.CreatorID,
104				Status:     store.UNREAD,
105				Message: &storepb.InboxMessage{
106					Type: storepb.InboxMessage_MEMO_COMMENT,
107					Payload: &storepb.InboxMessage_MemoComment{
108						MemoComment: &storepb.InboxMessage_MemoCommentPayload{
109							MemoId:        memo.ID,
110							RelatedMemoId: relatedMemo.ID,
111						},
112					},
113				},
114			}); err != nil {
115				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create inbox")
116			}
117		}
118	
119		if err := s.DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook(ctx, memoComment, relatedMemo.CreatorID); err != nil {
120			slog.Warn("Failed to dispatch memo comment created webhook", slog.Any("err", err))
121		}
122	
123		s.dispatchMemoMentionNotificationsBestEffort(ctx, memo, relatedMemo, "")
124	
125		// Broadcast live refresh event for the parent memo so subscribers see the new comment.
126		s.SSEHub.Broadcast(&SSEEvent{
127			Type:       SSEEventMemoCommentCreated,
128			Name:       request.Name,
129			Visibility: relatedMemo.Visibility,
130			CreatorID:  relatedMemo.CreatorID,
131		})
132	
133		return memoComment, nil
134	}
