136	func (s *APIV1Service) ListMemoComments(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.ListMemoCommentsRequest) (*v1pb.ListMemoCommentsResponse, error) {
137		memoUID, err := ExtractMemoUIDFromName(request.Name)
138		if err != nil {
139			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo name: %v", err)
140		}
141		memo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{UID: &memoUID})
142		if err != nil {
143			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get memo")
144		}
145		if memo == nil {
146			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
147		}
148		if err := s.checkMemoReadAccess(ctx, memo); err != nil {
149			return nil, err
150		}
151	
152		currentUser, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
153		if err != nil {
154			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")
155		}
156		var memoFilter string
157		if currentUser == nil {
158			memoFilter = `visibility == "PUBLIC"`
159		} else {
160			memoFilter = fmt.Sprintf(`creator_id == %d || visibility in ["PUBLIC", "PROTECTED"]`, currentUser.ID)
161		}
162		memoRelationComment := store.MemoRelationComment
163		var limit, offset int
164		if request.PageToken != "" {
165			var pageToken v1pb.PageToken
166			if err := unmarshalPageToken(request.PageToken, &pageToken); err != nil {
167				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid page token: %v", err)
168			}
169			limit = normalizePageSize(pageToken.Limit)
170			offset = max(int(pageToken.Offset), 0)
171		} else {
172			limit = normalizePageSize(request.PageSize)
173		}
174		limitPlusOne := limit + 1
175		memoRelations, err := s.Store.ListMemoRelations(ctx, &store.FindMemoRelation{
176			RelatedMemoID: &memo.ID,
177			Type:          &memoRelationComment,
178			MemoFilter:    &memoFilter,
179			Limit:         &limitPlusOne,
180			Offset:        &offset,
181		})
182		if err != nil {
183			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list memo relations")
184		}
185	
186		nextPageToken := ""
187		if len(memoRelations) == limitPlusOne {
188			memoRelations = memoRelations[:limit]
189			nextPageToken, err = getPageToken(limit, offset+limit)
190			if err != nil {
191				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get next page token, error: %v", err)
192			}
193		}
194	
195		if len(memoRelations) == 0 {
196			response := &v1pb.ListMemoCommentsResponse{
197				Memos:         []*v1pb.Memo{},
198				NextPageToken: nextPageToken,
199			}
200			return response, nil
201		}
202	
203		memoRelationIDs := make([]int32, 0, len(memoRelations))
204		for _, m := range memoRelations {
205			memoRelationIDs = append(memoRelationIDs, m.MemoID)
206		}
207		memos, err := s.Store.ListMemos(ctx, &store.FindMemo{IDList: memoRelationIDs})
208		if err != nil {
209			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list memos")
210		}
211	
212		memoIDToNameMap := make(map[int32]string)
213		contentIDs := make([]string, 0, len(memos))
214		memoIDsForAttachments := make([]int32, 0, len(memos))
215	
216		for _, memo := range memos {
217			memoName := fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", MemoNamePrefix, memo.UID)
218			memoIDToNameMap[memo.ID] = memoName
219			contentIDs = append(contentIDs, memoName)
220			memoIDsForAttachments = append(memoIDsForAttachments, memo.ID)
221		}
222		reactions, err := s.Store.ListReactions(ctx, &store.FindReaction{ContentIDList: contentIDs})
223		if err != nil {
224			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list reactions")
225		}
226	
227		memoReactionsMap := make(map[string][]*store.Reaction)
228		for _, reaction := range reactions {
229			memoReactionsMap[reaction.ContentID] = append(memoReactionsMap[reaction.ContentID], reaction)
230		}
231	
232		attachments, err := s.Store.ListAttachments(ctx, &store.FindAttachment{MemoIDList: memoIDsForAttachments})
233		if err != nil {
234			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list attachments")
235		}
236		attachmentMap := make(map[int32][]*store.Attachment)
237		for _, attachment := range attachments {
238			attachmentMap[*attachment.MemoID] = append(attachmentMap[*attachment.MemoID], attachment)
239		}
240	
241		// RELATIONS (batch load to avoid N+1)
242		relationMap, err := s.batchConvertMemoRelations(ctx, memos, false)
243		if err != nil {
244			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to batch load memo relations")
245		}
246		creatorIDs := make([]int32, 0, len(memos)+len(reactions))
247		for _, memo := range memos {
248			creatorIDs = append(creatorIDs, memo.CreatorID)
249		}
250		for _, reaction := range reactions {
251			creatorIDs = append(creatorIDs, reaction.CreatorID)
252		}
253		creatorMap, err := s.listUsersByID(ctx, creatorIDs)
254		if err != nil {
255			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list memo creators: %v", err)
256		}
257		var memosResponse []*v1pb.Memo
258		for _, m := range memos {
259			memoName := memoIDToNameMap[m.ID]
260			reactions := memoReactionsMap[memoName]
261			attachments := attachmentMap[m.ID]
262			relations := relationMap[m.ID]
263	
264			memoMessage, err := s.convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators(ctx, m, reactions, attachments, relations, creatorMap)
265			if err != nil {
266				if stderrors.Is(err, errMemoCreatorNotFound) {
267					slog.Warn("Skipping memo comment with missing creator",
268						slog.Int64("memo_id", int64(m.ID)),
269						slog.String("memo_uid", m.UID),
270						slog.Int64("creator_id", int64(m.CreatorID)),
271						slog.String("parent_name", request.Name),
272					)
273					continue
274				}
275				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to convert memo")
276			}
277			memosResponse = append(memosResponse, memoMessage)
278		}
279	
280		response := &v1pb.ListMemoCommentsResponse{
281			Memos:         memosResponse,
282			NextPageToken: nextPageToken,
283		}
284		return response, nil
285	}

57	// safeDialContext is a net.Dialer.DialContext replacement that resolves the target
58	// hostname and rejects any address that falls within a reserved/private IP range.
59	func safeDialContext(ctx context.Context, network, addr string) (net.Conn, error) {
60		host, port, err := net.SplitHostPort(addr)
61		if err != nil {
62			return nil, errors.Errorf("webhook: invalid address %q", addr)
63		}
64	
65		ips, err := net.DefaultResolver.LookupHost(ctx, host)
66		if err != nil {
67			return nil, errors.Wrapf(err, "webhook: failed to resolve host %q", host)
68		}
69	
70		for _, ipStr := range ips {
71			if ip := net.ParseIP(ipStr); ip != nil && isReservedIP(ip) {
72				return nil, errors.Errorf("webhook: connection to reserved/private IP address is not allowed")
73			}
74		}
75	
76		return (&net.Dialer{}).DialContext(ctx, network, net.JoinHostPort(host, port))

92	// resolveSigningKey returns the raw HMAC key for a signing secret. Secrets using
93	// the Standard Webhooks "whsec_<base64>" serialization are base64-decoded to their
94	// raw bytes; any other secret is used as-is. It returns an error when a whsec_-prefixed
95	// secret is not valid base64, so callers fail loudly instead of silently signing with
96	// the wrong key (which would make every signature unverifiable by the receiver).
97	func resolveSigningKey(secret string) ([]byte, error) {
98		if rest, ok := strings.CutPrefix(secret, "whsec_"); ok {
99			decoded, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(rest)
100			if err != nil {
101				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "signing secret has whsec_ prefix but is not valid base64")
102			}
103			return decoded, nil
104		}
105		return []byte(secret), nil
106	}

108	// GenerateSigningSecret returns a new Standard Webhooks signing secret in the
109	// "whsec_<base64>" form, backed by 32 cryptographically-random bytes — comfortably
110	// within the spec's 24–64 byte range.
111	func GenerateSigningSecret() (string, error) {
112		buf := make([]byte, 32)
113		if _, err := rand.Read(buf); err != nil {
114			return "", errors.Wrap(err, "failed to read random bytes for signing secret")
115		}
116		return "whsec_" + base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(buf), nil
117	}

119	// Post posts the message to webhook endpoint.

126		req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", requestPayload.URL, bytes.NewBuffer(body))
127		if err != nil {
128			return errors.Wrapf(err, "failed to construct webhook request to %s", requestPayload.URL)
129		}

131		req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
132	
133		if requestPayload.SigningSecret != "" {
134			key, err := resolveSigningKey(requestPayload.SigningSecret)
135			if err != nil {
136				return errors.Wrapf(err, "failed to derive signing key for webhook to %s", requestPayload.URL)
137			}

139			msgID := "msg_" + uuid.New().String()
140			timestamp := strconv.FormatInt(time.Now().Unix(), 10)

142			mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, key)
143			mac.Write([]byte(msgID + "." + timestamp + "."))
144			mac.Write(body)
145			signature := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
146	
147			req.Header.Set("webhook-id", msgID)
148			req.Header.Set("webhook-timestamp", timestamp)

48	func (s *APIV1Service) dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook(ctx context.Context, memo *v1pb.Memo, activityType string) error {

53	func (s *APIV1Service) CreateUserWebhook(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.CreateUserWebhookRequest) (*v1pb.UserWebhook, error) {
54		user, err := s.resolveUserFromName(ctx, request.Parent)
55		if err != nil {

57		}
58		userID := user.ID
59	
60		currentUser, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
61		if err != nil {
62			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get current user: %v", err)
63		}
64		if currentUser == nil {
65			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
66		}
67		if currentUser.ID != userID && currentUser.Role != store.RoleAdmin {
68			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
69		}
70	
71		if request.Webhook.Url == "" {
72			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "webhook URL is required")
73		}
74		if err := webhook.ValidateURL(strings.TrimSpace(request.Webhook.Url)); err != nil {
75			return nil, err
76		}
77		// The signing secret is generated server-side so it always meets the Standard
78		// Webhooks length requirement. A client-supplied secret is still accepted (and
79		// validated) for backward compatibility.
80		signingSecret := strings.TrimSpace(request.Webhook.SigningSecret)
81		if signingSecret == "" {
82			signingSecret, err = webhook.GenerateSigningSecret()
83			if err != nil {
84				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to generate signing secret: %v", err)
85			}
86		} else if err := webhook.ValidateSigningSecret(signingSecret); err != nil {
87			return nil, err
88		}
89	
90		webhookID := generateUserWebhookID()
91		webhook := &storepb.WebhooksUserSetting_Webhook{
92			Id:            webhookID,
93			Title:         request.Webhook.DisplayName,
94			Url:           strings.TrimSpace(request.Webhook.Url),
95			SigningSecret: signingSecret,
96		}
97	
98		err = s.Store.AddUserWebhook(ctx, userID, webhook)

106	func (s *APIV1Service) UpdateUserWebhook(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.UpdateUserWebhookRequest) (*v1pb.UserWebhook, error) {
107		if request.Webhook == nil {
108			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "webhook is required")
109		}
110	
111		user, webhookID, err := s.resolveUserAndWebhookIDFromName(ctx, request.Webhook.Name)
112		if err != nil {
113			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid webhook name: %v", err)
114		}
115		userID := user.ID
116	
117		currentUser, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
118		if err != nil {
119			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get current user: %v", err)
120		}
121		if currentUser == nil {
122			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
123		}
124		if currentUser.ID != userID && currentUser.Role != store.RoleAdmin {
125			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
126		}
127	
128		// Get existing webhooks
129		webhooks, err := s.Store.GetUserWebhooks(ctx, userID)
130		if err != nil {
131			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user webhooks: %v", err)
132		}
133	
134		// Find the webhook to update
135		var targetWebhook *storepb.WebhooksUserSetting_Webhook
136		for _, webhook := range webhooks {
137			if webhook.Id == webhookID {
138				targetWebhook = webhook
139				break
140			}
141		}
142	
143		if targetWebhook == nil {
144			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "webhook not found")
145		}
146	
147		// Update the webhook
148		updatedWebhook := &storepb.WebhooksUserSetting_Webhook{
149			Id:            webhookID,
150			Title:         targetWebhook.Title,
151			Url:           targetWebhook.Url,
152			SigningSecret: targetWebhook.SigningSecret,
153		}
154	
155		if request.UpdateMask != nil {
156			for _, path := range request.UpdateMask.Paths {
157				switch path {
158				case "url":
159					if request.Webhook.Url != "" {
160						trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(request.Webhook.Url)
161						if err := webhook.ValidateURL(trimmed); err != nil {
162							return nil, err
163						}
164						updatedWebhook.Url = trimmed
165					}
166				case "display_name":
167					updatedWebhook.Title = request.Webhook.DisplayName
168				case "signing_secret":
169					secret := strings.TrimSpace(request.Webhook.SigningSecret)
170					if err := webhook.ValidateSigningSecret(secret); err != nil {
171						return nil, err
172					}
173					updatedWebhook.SigningSecret = secret
174				default:
175					// Ignore unsupported fields
176				}
177			}
178		} else {
179			// If no update mask is provided, update all fields
180			if request.Webhook.Url != "" {
181				trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(request.Webhook.Url)
182				if err := webhook.ValidateURL(trimmed); err != nil {
183					return nil, err
184				}
185				updatedWebhook.Url = trimmed
186			}
187			updatedWebhook.Title = request.Webhook.DisplayName
188			if request.Webhook.SigningSecret != "" {
189				secret := strings.TrimSpace(request.Webhook.SigningSecret)
190				if err := webhook.ValidateSigningSecret(secret); err != nil {
191					return nil, err
192				}
193				updatedWebhook.SigningSecret = secret
194			}
195		}
196	
197		err = s.Store.UpdateUserWebhook(ctx, userID, updatedWebhook)
198		if err != nil {
199			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to update webhook: %v", err)
200		}
201	
202		return convertUserWebhookFromUserSetting(updatedWebhook, user), nil
203	}

39	func (s *APIV1Service) checkMemoReadAccess(ctx context.Context, memo *store.Memo) error {
40		if memo == nil {
41			return status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
42		}
43	
44		// Archived memos are only visible to their creator.
45		if memo.RowStatus == store.Archived {
46			user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
47			if err != nil {
48				return status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")
49			}
50			if user == nil || memo.CreatorID != user.ID {
51				return status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
52			}
53		}
54	
55		if memo.Visibility != store.Public {
56			user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
57			if err != nil {
58				return status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")
59			}
60			if user == nil {
61				return status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
62			}
63			if memo.Visibility == store.Private && memo.CreatorID != user.ID {
64				return status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
65			}
66		}
67		return nil
68	}

70	func (s *APIV1Service) CreateMemo(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.CreateMemoRequest) (*v1pb.Memo, error) {
71		user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
72		if err != nil {
73			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")
74		}
75		if user == nil {
76			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
77		}
78	
79		memoUID, err := ValidateAndGenerateUID(request.MemoId)
80		if err != nil {
81			return nil, err
82		}
83	
84		create := &store.Memo{
85			UID:        memoUID,
86			CreatorID:  user.ID,
87			Content:    request.Memo.Content,
88			Visibility: convertVisibilityToStore(request.Memo.Visibility),
89		}
90	
91		// Set custom timestamps if provided in the request.
92		if request.Memo.CreateTime != nil && request.Memo.CreateTime.IsValid() {
93			createdTs := request.Memo.CreateTime.AsTime().Unix()
94			create.CreatedTs = createdTs
95		}
96		if request.Memo.UpdateTime != nil && request.Memo.UpdateTime.IsValid() {
97			updatedTs := request.Memo.UpdateTime.AsTime().Unix()
98			create.UpdatedTs = updatedTs
99		}
100	
101		contentLengthLimit, err := s.getContentLengthLimit(ctx)
102		if err != nil {
103			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get content length limit")
104		}
105		if len(create.Content) > contentLengthLimit {
106			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "content too long (max %d characters)", contentLengthLimit)
107		}
108		if err := memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, create, s.MarkdownService); err != nil {
109			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to rebuild memo payload: %v", err)
110		}
111		if request.Memo.Location != nil {
112			create.Payload.Location = convertLocationToStore(request.Memo.Location)
113		}
114	
115		memo, err := s.Store.CreateMemo(ctx, create)
116		if err != nil {
117			// Check for unique constraint violation (AIP-133 compliance)
118			errMsg := err.Error()
119			if strings.Contains(errMsg, "UNIQUE constraint failed") ||
120				strings.Contains(errMsg, "duplicate key") ||
121				strings.Contains(errMsg, "Duplicate entry") {
122				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.AlreadyExists, "memo with ID %q already exists", memoUID)
123			}
124			return nil, err
125		}
126	
127		attachments := []*store.Attachment{}
128	
129		if len(request.Memo.Attachments) > 0 {
130			if err := s.setMemoAttachmentsInternal(ctx, user, memo, request.Memo.Attachments); err != nil {
131				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to set memo attachments")
132			}
133	
134			a, err := s.Store.ListAttachments(ctx, &store.FindAttachment{
135				MemoID: &memo.ID,
136			})
137			if err != nil {
138				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get memo attachments")
139			}
140			attachments = a
141		}
142		if len(request.Memo.Relations) > 0 {
143			if err := s.setMemoRelationsInternal(ctx, memo, request.Memo.Relations); err != nil {
144				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to set memo relations")
145			}
146		}
147	
148		relations, err := s.loadMemoRelations(ctx, memo)
149		if err != nil {
150			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to load memo relations")
151		}
152		memoMessage, err := s.convertMemoFromStore(ctx, memo, nil, attachments, relations)
153		if err != nil {
154			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to convert memo")
155		}
156		// Try to dispatch webhook when memo is created.
157		if err := s.DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook(ctx, memoMessage); err != nil {
158			slog.Warn("Failed to dispatch memo created webhook", slog.Any("err", err))
159		}
160	
161		// Broadcast live refresh event (skipped when called from CreateMemoComment).
162		if !isSSESuppressed(ctx) {
163			s.SSEHub.Broadcast(&SSEEvent{
164				Type:       SSEEventMemoCreated,
165				Name:       memoMessage.Name,
166				Visibility: memo.Visibility,
167				CreatorID:  resolveSSECreatorID(memo, nil),
168			})
169		}
170	
171		if !isMentionNotificationSuppressed(ctx) {
172			s.dispatchMemoMentionNotificationsBestEffort(ctx, memo, nil, "")
173		}
174	
175		return memoMessage, nil
176	}

178	func (s *APIV1Service) ListMemos(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.ListMemosRequest) (*v1pb.ListMemosResponse, error) {
179		memoFind := &store.FindMemo{
180			// Exclude comments by default.
181			ExcludeComments: true,
182		}
183		currentUser, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
184		if err != nil {
185			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")
186		}
187	
188		if request.State == v1pb.State_ARCHIVED {
189			state := store.Archived
190			memoFind.RowStatus = &state
191			// Archived memos are only visible to their creator.
192			if currentUser == nil {
193				return &v1pb.ListMemosResponse{}, nil
194			}
195			memoFind.CreatorID = &currentUser.ID
196		} else {
197			state := store.Normal
198			memoFind.RowStatus = &state
199		}
200	
201		// Parse order_by field (replaces the old sort and direction fields)
202		if request.OrderBy != "" {
203			if err := s.parseMemoOrderBy(request.OrderBy, memoFind); err != nil {
204				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid order_by: %v", err)
205			}
206		} else {
207			// Default ordering by create_time desc.
208			memoFind.OrderByTimeAsc = false
209		}
210	
211		if request.Filter != "" {
212			if err := s.validateFilter(ctx, request.Filter); err != nil {
213				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid filter: %v", err)
214			}
215			memoFind.Filters = append(memoFind.Filters, request.Filter)
216		}
217	
218		if currentUser == nil {
219			memoFind.VisibilityList = []store.Visibility{store.Public}
220		} else {
221			if memoFind.CreatorID == nil {
222				filter := fmt.Sprintf(`creator_id == %d || visibility in ["PUBLIC", "PROTECTED"]`, currentUser.ID)
223				memoFind.Filters = append(memoFind.Filters, filter)
224			} else if *memoFind.CreatorID != currentUser.ID {
225				memoFind.VisibilityList = []store.Visibility{store.Public, store.Protected}
226			}
227		}
228	
229		var limit, offset int
230		if request.PageToken != "" {
231			var pageToken v1pb.PageToken
232			if err := unmarshalPageToken(request.PageToken, &pageToken); err != nil {
233				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid page token: %v", err)
234			}
235			limit = normalizePageSize(pageToken.Limit)
236			offset = max(int(pageToken.Offset), 0)
237		} else {
238			limit = normalizePageSize(request.PageSize)
239		}
240		limit = min(limit, MaxPageSize)
241		limitPlusOne := limit + 1
242		memoFind.Limit = &limitPlusOne
243		memoFind.Offset = &offset
244		memos, err := s.Store.ListMemos(ctx, memoFind)
245		if err != nil {
246			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list memos: %v", err)
247		}
248	
249		memoMessages := []*v1pb.Memo{}
250		nextPageToken := ""
251		if len(memos) == limitPlusOne {
252			memos = memos[:limit]
253			nextPageToken, err = getPageToken(limit, offset+limit)
254			if err != nil {
255				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get next page token, error: %v", err)
256			}
257		}
258	
259		if len(memos) == 0 {
260			response := &v1pb.ListMemosResponse{
261				Memos:         memoMessages,
262				NextPageToken: nextPageToken,
263			}
264			return response, nil
265		}
266	
267		reactionMap := make(map[string][]*store.Reaction)
268		contentIDs := make([]string, 0, len(memos))
269	
270		attachmentMap := make(map[int32][]*store.Attachment)
271		memoIDs := make([]int32, 0, len(memos))
272	
273		for _, m := range memos {
274			contentIDs = append(contentIDs, fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", MemoNamePrefix, m.UID))
275			memoIDs = append(memoIDs, m.ID)
276		}
277	
278		// REACTIONS
279		reactions, err := s.Store.ListReactions(ctx, &store.FindReaction{ContentIDList: contentIDs})
280		if err != nil {
281			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list reactions")
282		}
283		for _, reaction := range reactions {
284			reactionMap[reaction.ContentID] = append(reactionMap[reaction.ContentID], reaction)
285		}
286	
287		// ATTACHMENTS
288		attachments, err := s.Store.ListAttachments(ctx, &store.FindAttachment{MemoIDList: memoIDs})
289		if err != nil {
290			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list attachments")
291		}
292		for _, attachment := range attachments {
293			attachmentMap[*attachment.MemoID] = append(attachmentMap[*attachment.MemoID], attachment)
294		}
295	
296		// RELATIONS (batch load to avoid N+1)
297		relationMap, err := s.batchConvertMemoRelations(ctx, memos, false)
298		if err != nil {
299			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to batch load memo relations")
300		}
301		creatorIDs := make([]int32, 0, len(memos)+len(reactions))
302		for _, memo := range memos {
303			creatorIDs = append(creatorIDs, memo.CreatorID)
304		}
305		for _, reaction := range reactions {
306			creatorIDs = append(creatorIDs, reaction.CreatorID)
307		}
308		creatorMap, err := s.listUsersByID(ctx, creatorIDs)
309		if err != nil {
310			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list memo creators: %v", err)
311		}
312		for _, memo := range memos {
313			memoName := fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", MemoNamePrefix, memo.UID)
314			reactions := reactionMap[memoName]
315			attachments := attachmentMap[memo.ID]
316			relations := relationMap[memo.ID]
317	
318			memoMessage, err := s.convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators(ctx, memo, reactions, attachments, relations, creatorMap)
319			if err != nil {
320				if stderrors.Is(err, errMemoCreatorNotFound) {
321					slog.Warn("Skipping memo with missing creator",
322						slog.Int64("memo_id", int64(memo.ID)),
323						slog.String("memo_uid", memo.UID),
324						slog.Int64("creator_id", int64(memo.CreatorID)),
325					)
326					continue
327				}
328				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to convert memo")
329			}
330	
331			memoMessages = append(memoMessages, memoMessage)
332		}
333	
334		response := &v1pb.ListMemosResponse{
335			Memos:         memoMessages,
336			NextPageToken: nextPageToken,
337		}
338		return response, nil
339	}

341	func (s *APIV1Service) GetMemo(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.GetMemoRequest) (*v1pb.Memo, error) {
342		memoUID, err := ExtractMemoUIDFromName(request.Name)
343		if err != nil {
344			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo name: %v", err)
345		}
346		memo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{
347			UID: &memoUID,
348		})
349		if err != nil {
350			return nil, err
351		}
352		if memo == nil {
353			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
354		}
355	
356		if err := s.checkMemoReadAccess(ctx, memo); err != nil {
357			return nil, err
358		}
359		if memo.ParentUID != nil {
360			parentMemo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{UID: memo.ParentUID})
361			if err != nil {
362				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get parent memo")
363			}
364			if parentMemo == nil {
365				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
366			}
367			if err := s.checkMemoReadAccess(ctx, parentMemo); err != nil {
368				return nil, err
369			}
370		}
371	
372		reactions, err := s.Store.ListReactions(ctx, &store.FindReaction{
373			ContentID: &request.Name,
374		})
375		if err != nil {
376			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list reactions")
377		}
378	
379		attachments, err := s.Store.ListAttachments(ctx, &store.FindAttachment{
380			MemoID: &memo.ID,
381		})
382		if err != nil {
383			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list attachments")
384		}
385	
386		relations, err := s.loadMemoRelations(ctx, memo)
387		if err != nil {
388			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to load memo relations")
389		}
390		memoMessage, err := s.convertMemoFromStore(ctx, memo, reactions, attachments, relations)
391		if err != nil {
392			if stderrors.Is(err, errMemoCreatorNotFound) {
393				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo creator not found")
394			}
395			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to convert memo")
396		}
397		return memoMessage, nil
398	}

401	func (s *APIV1Service) UpdateMemo(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.UpdateMemoRequest) (*v1pb.Memo, error) {
402		memoUID, err := ExtractMemoUIDFromName(request.Memo.Name)
403		if err != nil {
404			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo name: %v", err)
405		}
406		if request.UpdateMask == nil || len(request.UpdateMask.Paths) == 0 {
407			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "update mask is required")
408		}
409	
410		memo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{UID: &memoUID})
411		if err != nil {
412			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get memo: %v", err)
413		}
414		if memo == nil {
415			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
416		}
417	
418		user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
419		if err != nil {
420			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get current user")
421		}
422		if user == nil {
423			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
424		}
425		// Only the creator or admin can update the memo.
426		if memo.CreatorID != user.ID && !isSuperUser(user) {
427			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
428		}
429	
430		update := &store.UpdateMemo{
431			ID: memo.ID,
432		}
433		var previousContent string
434		contentUpdated := false
435		for _, path := range request.UpdateMask.Paths {
436			if path == "content" {
437				contentUpdated = true
438				previousContent = memo.Content
439				contentLengthLimit, err := s.getContentLengthLimit(ctx)
440				if err != nil {
441					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get content length limit")
442				}
443				if len(request.Memo.Content) > contentLengthLimit {
444					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "content too long (max %d characters)", contentLengthLimit)
445				}
446				memo.Content = request.Memo.Content
447				if err := memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, memo, s.MarkdownService); err != nil {
448					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to rebuild memo payload: %v", err)
449				}
450				update.Content = &memo.Content
451				update.Payload = memo.Payload
452			} else if path == "visibility" {
453				visibility := convertVisibilityToStore(request.Memo.Visibility)
454				if memo.ParentUID != nil {
455					parentMemo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{UID: memo.ParentUID})
456					if err != nil {
457						return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get parent memo")
458					}
459					if parentMemo == nil {
460						return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
461					}
462					visibility = parentMemo.Visibility
463				}
464				update.Visibility = &visibility
465			} else if path == "pinned" {
466				update.Pinned = &request.Memo.Pinned
467			} else if path == "state" {
468				rowStatus := convertStateToStore(request.Memo.State)
469				update.RowStatus = &rowStatus
470			} else if path == "create_time" {
471				createdTs := request.Memo.CreateTime.AsTime().Unix()
472				update.CreatedTs = &createdTs
473			} else if path == "update_time" {
474				updatedTs := time.Now().Unix()
475				if request.Memo.UpdateTime != nil {
476					updatedTs = request.Memo.UpdateTime.AsTime().Unix()
477				}
478				update.UpdatedTs = &updatedTs
479			} else if path == "display_time" {
480				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "display_time is not supported")
481			} else if path == "location" {
482				payload := memo.Payload
483				payload.Location = convertLocationToStore(request.Memo.Location)
484				update.Payload = payload
485			} else if path == "attachments" {
486				if err := s.setMemoAttachmentsInternal(ctx, user, memo, request.Memo.Attachments); err != nil {
487					return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to set memo attachments")
488				}
489			} else if path == "relations" {
490				if err := s.setMemoRelationsInternal(ctx, memo, request.Memo.Relations); err != nil {
491					return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to set memo relations")
492				}
493			}
494		}
495	
496		if err = s.Store.UpdateMemo(ctx, update); err != nil {
497			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to update memo")

524			UID: &memoUID,

526		if err != nil {
527			return nil, err
528		}
529		if memo == nil {

531		}
532	
533		user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)

536		}
537		if user == nil {

539		}

541		if memo.CreatorID != user.ID && !isSuperUser(user) {
542			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
543		}
544	
545		reactions, err := s.Store.ListReactions(ctx, &store.FindReaction{
546			ContentID: &request.Name,

548		if err != nil {

581			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to delete memo")

584		// Broadcast live refresh event.

19	// CreateMemoComment creates a comment on an existing memo.
20	func (s *APIV1Service) CreateMemoComment(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.CreateMemoCommentRequest) (*v1pb.Memo, error) {
21		memoUID, err := ExtractMemoUIDFromName(request.Name)
22		if err != nil {
23			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo name: %v", err)
24		}
25		relatedMemo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{UID: &memoUID})
26		if err != nil {
27			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get memo")
28		}
29		if relatedMemo == nil {
30			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
31		}
32	
33		// Check memo visibility before allowing comment.
34		user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
35		if err != nil {
36			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")
37		}
38		if user == nil {
39			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
40		}
41		if relatedMemo.Visibility == store.Private && relatedMemo.CreatorID != user.ID && !isSuperUser(user) {
42			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
43		}
44		if request.Comment == nil {
45			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "comment is required")
46		}
47	
48		comment, ok := proto.Clone(request.Comment).(*v1pb.Memo)
49		if !ok {
50			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to clone memo comment")
51		}
52		comment.Visibility = convertVisibilityFromStore(relatedMemo.Visibility)
53	
54		// Create the memo comment first; suppress the generic memo.created SSE event
55		// since CreateMemoComment broadcasts memo.comment.created for the parent instead.
56		memoComment, err := s.CreateMemo(withSuppressMentionNotifications(withSuppressSSE(ctx)), &v1pb.CreateMemoRequest{
57			Memo:   comment,
58			MemoId: request.CommentId,
59		})
60		if err != nil {
61			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create memo")
62		}
63		memoUID, err = ExtractMemoUIDFromName(memoComment.Name)
64		if err != nil {
65			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo name: %v", err)
66		}
67		memo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{UID: &memoUID})
68		if err != nil {
69			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get memo")
70		}
71	
72		// Build the relation between the comment memo and the original memo.
73		_, err = s.Store.UpsertMemoRelation(ctx, &store.MemoRelation{
74			MemoID:        memo.ID,
75			RelatedMemoID: relatedMemo.ID,
76			Type:          store.MemoRelationComment,
77		})
78		if err != nil {
79			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create memo relation")
80		}
81	
82		// The comment memo was converted before the relation above existed, so its
83		// Relations slice is empty. Reload the relations now so that both the API
84		// response and the memo.comment.created webhook payload carry the relation
85		// to the parent memo.
86		relations, err := s.loadMemoRelations(ctx, memo)
87		if err != nil {
88			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to load memo relations")
89		}
90		memoComment.Relations = relations
91	
92		creator, err := ResolveUserByName(ctx, s.Store, memoComment.Creator)
93		if err != nil {
94			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo creator")
95		}
96		if creator == nil {
97			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo creator not found")
98		}
99		creatorID := creator.ID
100		if memoComment.Visibility != v1pb.Visibility_PRIVATE && creatorID != relatedMemo.CreatorID {
101			if _, err := s.createInboxWithEmailNotification(ctx, &store.Inbox{
102				SenderID:   creatorID,
103				ReceiverID: relatedMemo.CreatorID,
104				Status:     store.UNREAD,
105				Message: &storepb.InboxMessage{
106					Type: storepb.InboxMessage_MEMO_COMMENT,
107					Payload: &storepb.InboxMessage_MemoComment{
108						MemoComment: &storepb.InboxMessage_MemoCommentPayload{
109							MemoId:        memo.ID,
110							RelatedMemoId: relatedMemo.ID,
111						},
112					},
113				},
114			}); err != nil {
115				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create inbox")
116			}
117		}
118	
119		if err := s.DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook(ctx, memoComment, relatedMemo.CreatorID); err != nil {
120			slog.Warn("Failed to dispatch memo comment created webhook", slog.Any("err", err))
121		}
122	
123		s.dispatchMemoMentionNotificationsBestEffort(ctx, memo, relatedMemo, "")
124	
125		// Broadcast live refresh event for the parent memo so subscribers see the new comment.
126		s.SSEHub.Broadcast(&SSEEvent{
127			Type:       SSEEventMemoCommentCreated,
128			Name:       request.Name,
129			Visibility: relatedMemo.Visibility,
130			CreatorID:  relatedMemo.CreatorID,
131		})
132	
133		return memoComment, nil
134	}

136	func (s *APIV1Service) ListMemoComments(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.ListMemoCommentsRequest) (*v1pb.ListMemoCommentsResponse, error) {
137		memoUID, err := ExtractMemoUIDFromName(request.Name)
138		if err != nil {
139			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo name: %v", err)
140		}
141		memo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{UID: &memoUID})
142		if err != nil {
143			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get memo")
144		}
145		if memo == nil {
146			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
147		}
148		if err := s.checkMemoReadAccess(ctx, memo); err != nil {
149			return nil, err
150		}
151	
152		currentUser, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
153		if err != nil {
154			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")
155		}
156		var memoFilter string
157		if currentUser == nil {
158			memoFilter = `visibility == "PUBLIC"`
159		} else {
160			memoFilter = fmt.Sprintf(`creator_id == %d || visibility in ["PUBLIC", "PROTECTED"]`, currentUser.ID)
161		}
162		memoRelationComment := store.MemoRelationComment
163		var limit, offset int
164		if request.PageToken != "" {
165			var pageToken v1pb.PageToken
166			if err := unmarshalPageToken(request.PageToken, &pageToken); err != nil {
167				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid page token: %v", err)
168			}
169			limit = normalizePageSize(pageToken.Limit)
170			offset = max(int(pageToken.Offset), 0)
171		} else {
172			limit = normalizePageSize(request.PageSize)
173		}
174		limitPlusOne := limit + 1
175		memoRelations, err := s.Store.ListMemoRelations(ctx, &store.FindMemoRelation{
176			RelatedMemoID: &memo.ID,
177			Type:          &memoRelationComment,
178			MemoFilter:    &memoFilter,
179			Limit:         &limitPlusOne,
180			Offset:        &offset,
181		})
182		if err != nil {
183			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list memo relations")
184		}
185	
186		nextPageToken := ""
187		if len(memoRelations) == limitPlusOne {
188			memoRelations = memoRelations[:limit]
189			nextPageToken, err = getPageToken(limit, offset+limit)
190			if err != nil {
191				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get next page token, error: %v", err)
192			}
193		}
194	
195		if len(memoRelations) == 0 {
196			response := &v1pb.ListMemoCommentsResponse{
197				Memos:         []*v1pb.Memo{},
198				NextPageToken: nextPageToken,
199			}
200			return response, nil
201		}
202	
203		memoRelationIDs := make([]int32, 0, len(memoRelations))
204		for _, m := range memoRelations {
205			memoRelationIDs = append(memoRelationIDs, m.MemoID)
206		}
207		memos, err := s.Store.ListMemos(ctx, &store.FindMemo{IDList: memoRelationIDs})
208		if err != nil {
209			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list memos")
210		}
211	
212		memoIDToNameMap := make(map[int32]string)
213		contentIDs := make([]string, 0, len(memos))
214		memoIDsForAttachments := make([]int32, 0, len(memos))
215	
216		for _, memo := range memos {
217			memoName := fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", MemoNamePrefix, memo.UID)
218			memoIDToNameMap[memo.ID] = memoName
219			contentIDs = append(contentIDs, memoName)
220			memoIDsForAttachments = append(memoIDsForAttachments, memo.ID)
221		}
222		reactions, err := s.Store.ListReactions(ctx, &store.FindReaction{ContentIDList: contentIDs})
223		if err != nil {
224			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list reactions")
225		}
226	
227		memoReactionsMap := make(map[string][]*store.Reaction)
228		for _, reaction := range reactions {
229			memoReactionsMap[reaction.ContentID] = append(memoReactionsMap[reaction.ContentID], reaction)
230		}
231	
232		attachments, err := s.Store.ListAttachments(ctx, &store.FindAttachment{MemoIDList: memoIDsForAttachments})
233		if err != nil {
234			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list attachments")
235		}
236		attachmentMap := make(map[int32][]*store.Attachment)
237		for _, attachment := range attachments {
238			attachmentMap[*attachment.MemoID] = append(attachmentMap[*attachment.MemoID], attachment)
239		}
240	
241		// RELATIONS (batch load to avoid N+1)
242		relationMap, err := s.batchConvertMemoRelations(ctx, memos, false)
243		if err != nil {

119	func normalizeBatchUsernames(usernames []string) ([]string, int) {
120		uniqueUsernames := make([]string, 0, len(usernames))
121		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(usernames))
122		nonEmptyCount := 0
123		for _, username := range usernames {
124			username = strings.TrimSpace(username)
125			if username == "" {
126				continue
127			}
128			nonEmptyCount++
129			if _, ok := seen[username]; ok {
130				continue
131			}
132			seen[username] = struct{}{}
133			uniqueUsernames = append(uniqueUsernames, username)
134		}
135		return uniqueUsernames, nonEmptyCount
136	}

343					allowedAvatarTypes := map[string]bool{
344						"image/png":  true,
345						"image/jpeg": true,
346						"image/jpg":  true,
347						"image/gif":  true,
348						"image/webp": true,
349					}
350					if !allowedAvatarTypes[imageType] {
351						return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid avatar image type: %s. Only PNG, JPEG, GIF, and WebP are allowed", imageType)
352					}
353				}
354				update.AvatarURL = &request.User.AvatarUrl
355			case "description":
356				update.Description = &request.User.Description
357			case "role":

362				role := convertUserRoleToStore(request.User.Role)
363				update.Role = &role

367				}
368				passwordHash, err := bcrypt.GenerateFromPassword([]byte(request.User.Password), bcrypt.DefaultCost)

131	// serveAttachmentFile serves attachment binary content using native HTTP.
132	func (s *FileServerService) serveAttachmentFile(c *echo.Context) error {
133		ctx := c.Request().Context()
134		uid := c.Param("uid")
135		wantThumbnail := c.QueryParam("thumbnail") == "true"
136		wantMotion := c.QueryParam("motion") == "true"
137	
138		attachment, err := s.Store.GetAttachment(ctx, &store.FindAttachment{
139			UID:     &uid,
140			GetBlob: true,
141		})
142		if err != nil {
143			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get attachment").Wrap(err)
144		}
145		if attachment == nil {
146			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusNotFound, "attachment not found")
147		}
148	
149		if err := s.checkAttachmentPermission(ctx, c, attachment); err != nil {
150			return err
151		}
152	
153		if wantMotion {
154			return s.serveMotionClip(c, attachment)
155		}
156	
157		contentType := s.sanitizeContentType(attachment.Type)
158	
159		// Stream video/audio to avoid loading entire file into memory.
160		if isMediaType(attachment.Type) {
161			return s.serveMediaStream(c, attachment, contentType)
162		}
163	
164		return s.serveStaticFile(c, attachment, contentType, wantThumbnail)
165	}

167	// serveUserAvatar serves user avatar images.
168	func (s *FileServerService) serveUserAvatar(c *echo.Context) error {
169		ctx := c.Request().Context()
170	
171		// On a private instance (no InstanceURL), avatars are not exposed to anonymous
172		// visitors; a valid session, access token, or PAT is required.
173		if !s.Profile.AllowAnonymous() {
174			viewer, err := s.getCurrentUser(ctx, c)
175			if err != nil {
176				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get current user").Wrap(err)
177			}
178			if viewer == nil {
179				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized access")
180			}
181		}
182	
183		identifier := c.Param("identifier")
184	
185		user, err := s.getUserByUsername(ctx, identifier)
186		if err != nil {
187			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get user").Wrap(err)
188		}
189		if user == nil {
190			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusNotFound, "user not found")
191		}
192		if user.AvatarURL == "" {
193			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusNotFound, "avatar not found")
194		}
195	
196		imageType, imageData, err := s.parseDataURI(user.AvatarURL)
197		if err != nil {
198			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to parse avatar data").Wrap(err)
199		}
200	
201		if !avatarAllowedTypes[imageType] {
202			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid avatar image type")
203		}
204	
205		setSecurityHeaders(c)
206		c.Response().Header().Set(echo.HeaderContentType, imageType)
207		c.Response().Header().Set(echo.HeaderCacheControl, cacheMaxAge)
208	
209		return c.Blob(http.StatusOK, imageType, imageData)
210	}

216	// serveMediaStream serves video/audio files using streaming to avoid memory exhaustion.
217	func (s *FileServerService) serveMediaStream(c *echo.Context, attachment *store.Attachment, contentType string) error {
218		setSecurityHeaders(c)
219		setMediaHeaders(c, contentType, attachment.Type)
220	
221		switch attachment.StorageType {
222		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_LOCAL:
223			filePath, err := s.resolveLocalPath(attachment.Reference)
224			if err != nil {
225				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to resolve file path").Wrap(err)
226			}
227			http.ServeFile(c.Response(), c.Request(), filePath)
228			return nil
229	
230		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_S3:
231			presignURL, err := s.getS3PresignedURL(c.Request().Context(), attachment)
232			if err != nil {
233				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to generate presigned URL").Wrap(err)
234			}
235			return c.Redirect(http.StatusTemporaryRedirect, presignURL)
236	
237		default:
238			// Database storage fallback.
239			modTime := time.Unix(attachment.UpdatedTs, 0)
240			http.ServeContent(c.Response(), c.Request(), attachment.Filename, modTime, bytes.NewReader(attachment.Blob))
241			return nil
242		}
243	}
244	
245	// serveStaticFile serves non-streaming files (images, documents, etc.).
246	func (s *FileServerService) serveStaticFile(c *echo.Context, attachment *store.Attachment, contentType string, wantThumbnail bool) error {
247		// Generate thumbnail for supported image types.
248		if wantThumbnail && thumbnailSupportedTypes[attachment.Type] {
249			if thumbnailBlob, err := s.getOrGenerateThumbnail(c.Request().Context(), attachment); err != nil {
250				if !errors.Is(err, errUseOriginalForThumbnail) {
251					slog.Warn("failed to get thumbnail", "error", err)
252				}
253			} else {
254				setSecurityHeaders(c)
255				setMediaHeaders(c, "image/jpeg", attachment.Type)
256				return c.Blob(http.StatusOK, "image/jpeg", thumbnailBlob)
257			}
258		}
259	
260		setSecurityHeaders(c)
261		setMediaHeaders(c, contentType, attachment.Type)
262	
263		// Force download for non-media files to prevent XSS execution.
264		if !strings.HasPrefix(contentType, "image/") && contentType != "application/pdf" {
265			c.Response().Header().Set(echo.HeaderContentDisposition, fmt.Sprintf("attachment; filename=%q", attachment.Filename))
266		}
267	
268		switch attachment.StorageType {
269		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_LOCAL:
270			filePath, err := s.resolveLocalPath(attachment.Reference)
271			if err != nil {
272				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to resolve file path").Wrap(err)
273			}
274			http.ServeFile(c.Response(), c.Request(), filePath)
275			return nil
276		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_S3:
277			reader, err := s.getAttachmentReader(c.Request().Context(), attachment)
278			if err != nil {
279				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get attachment reader").Wrap(err)
280			}
281			defer reader.Close()
282			return c.Stream(http.StatusOK, contentType, reader)
283		default:
284			return c.Blob(http.StatusOK, contentType, attachment.Blob)
285		}
286	}

292	// getAttachmentBlob retrieves the binary content of an attachment from storage.
293	func (s *FileServerService) getAttachmentBlob(attachment *store.Attachment) ([]byte, error) {
294		switch attachment.StorageType {
295		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_LOCAL:
296			return s.readLocalFile(attachment.Reference)
297	
298		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_S3:
299			return s.downloadFromS3(context.Background(), attachment)
300	
301		default:
302			return attachment.Blob, nil
303		}
304	}

306	// getAttachmentReader returns a reader for streaming attachment content.
307	func (s *FileServerService) getAttachmentReader(ctx context.Context, attachment *store.Attachment) (io.ReadCloser, error) {
308		switch attachment.StorageType {
309		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_LOCAL:
310			filePath, err := s.resolveLocalPath(attachment.Reference)
311			if err != nil {
312				return nil, err
313			}
314			file, err := os.Open(filePath)
315			if err != nil {
316				if os.IsNotExist(err) {
317					return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "file not found")
318				}
319				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to open file")
320			}
321			return file, nil
322	
323		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_S3:
324			s3Client, s3Object, err := s.createS3Client(attachment)
325			if err != nil {
326				return nil, err
327			}
328			reader, err := s3Client.GetObjectStream(ctx, s3Object.Key)
329			if err != nil {
330				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to stream from S3")
331			}
332			return reader, nil
333	
334		default:
335			return io.NopCloser(bytes.NewReader(attachment.Blob)), nil
336		}
337	}

339	// resolveLocalPath converts a storage reference to an absolute file path.
340	func (s *FileServerService) resolveLocalPath(reference string) (string, error) {
341		filePath := filepath.FromSlash(reference)
342		if !filepath.IsAbs(filePath) {
343			filePath = filepath.Join(s.Profile.Data, filePath)
344		}
345		return filePath, nil
346	}

348	// readLocalFile reads the entire contents of a local file.
349	func (s *FileServerService) readLocalFile(reference string) ([]byte, error) {
350		filePath, err := s.resolveLocalPath(reference)
351		if err != nil {
352			return nil, err
353		}
354	
355		file, err := os.Open(filePath)
356		if err != nil {
357			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
358				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "file not found")
359			}
360			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to open file")
361		}
362		defer file.Close()
363	
364		blob, err := io.ReadAll(file)
365		if err != nil {
366			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to read file")
367		}
368		return blob, nil
369	}

371	// createS3Client creates an S3 client from attachment payload.
372	func (*FileServerService) createS3Client(attachment *store.Attachment) (*s3.Client, *storepb.AttachmentPayload_S3Object, error) {
373		if attachment.Payload == nil {
374			return nil, nil, errors.New("attachment payload is missing")
375		}
376		s3Object := attachment.Payload.GetS3Object()
377		if s3Object == nil {
378			return nil, nil, errors.New("S3 object payload is missing")
379		}
380		if s3Object.S3Config == nil {
381			return nil, nil, errors.New("S3 config is missing")
382		}
383		if s3Object.Key == "" {
384			return nil, nil, errors.New("S3 object key is missing")
385		}
386	
387		client, err := s3.NewClient(context.Background(), s3Object.S3Config)
388		if err != nil {
389			return nil, nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to create S3 client")
390		}
391		return client, s3Object, nil
392	}

394	// downloadFromS3 downloads the entire object from S3.
395	func (s *FileServerService) downloadFromS3(ctx context.Context, attachment *store.Attachment) ([]byte, error) {
396		client, s3Object, err := s.createS3Client(attachment)
397		if err != nil {
398			return nil, err
399		}
400	
401		blob, err := client.GetObject(ctx, s3Object.Key)
402		if err != nil {
403			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to download from S3")
404		}
405		return blob, nil
406	}

408	// getS3PresignedURL generates a presigned URL for direct S3 access.
409	func (s *FileServerService) getS3PresignedURL(ctx context.Context, attachment *store.Attachment) (string, error) {

413		}

416		if err != nil {

418		}

425	
426	// getOrGenerateThumbnail returns the thumbnail image of the attachment.
427	// Uses semaphore to limit concurrent thumbnail generation and prevent memory exhaustion.
428	func (s *FileServerService) getOrGenerateThumbnail(ctx context.Context, attachment *store.Attachment) ([]byte, error) {
429		thumbnailPath, err := s.getThumbnailPath(attachment)
430		if err != nil {
431			return nil, err
432		}
433	
434		// Fast path: return cached thumbnail if exists.
435		if blob, err := s.readCachedThumbnail(thumbnailPath); err == nil {
436			return blob, nil
437		}
438	
439		useOriginal, err := s.shouldUseOriginalForThumbnail(ctx, attachment)
440		if err != nil {
441			return nil, err
442		}
443		if useOriginal {
444			return nil, errUseOriginalForThumbnail
445		}
446	
447		// Acquire semaphore to limit concurrent generation.
448		if err := s.thumbnailSemaphore.Acquire(ctx, 1); err != nil {
449			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to acquire semaphore")
450		}
451		defer s.thumbnailSemaphore.Release(1)
452	
453		// Double-check after acquiring semaphore (another goroutine may have generated it).
454		if blob, err := s.readCachedThumbnail(thumbnailPath); err == nil {
455			return blob, nil
456		}
457	
458		return s.generateThumbnail(ctx, attachment, thumbnailPath)
459	}
460	
461	// getThumbnailPath returns the file path for a cached thumbnail.
462	func (s *FileServerService) getThumbnailPath(attachment *store.Attachment) (string, error) {
463		cacheFolder := filepath.Join(s.Profile.Data, ThumbnailCacheFolder)
464		if err := os.MkdirAll(cacheFolder, os.ModePerm); err != nil {
465			return "", errors.Wrap(err, "failed to create thumbnail cache folder")
466		}
467		filename := fmt.Sprintf("%s.v2.jpeg", attachment.UID)
468		return filepath.Join(cacheFolder, filename), nil
469	}

471	func (s *FileServerService) shouldUseOriginalForThumbnail(ctx context.Context, attachment *store.Attachment) (bool, error) {
472		if attachment.Type == "image/heic" || attachment.Type == "image/heif" {
473			return true, nil
474		}
475	
476		if attachment.Type != "image/jpeg" && attachment.Type != "image/jpg" && attachment.Type != "image/png" && attachment.Type != "image/webp" {
477			return false, nil
478		}
479	
480		reader, err := s.getAttachmentReader(ctx, attachment)
481		if err != nil {
482			return false, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to open image for metadata probe")
483		}
484		defer reader.Close()
485	
486		probe, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(reader, thumbnailMetadataProbeSize))
487		if err != nil {
488			return false, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to read image metadata probe")
489		}
490	
491		return hasThumbnailSensitiveMetadata(attachment.Type, probe), nil
492	}
493	
494	func hasThumbnailSensitiveMetadata(mimeType string, data []byte) bool {
495		if mimeType == "image/heic" || mimeType == "image/heif" {
496			return true
497		}
498	
499		for _, marker := range [][]byte{
500			[]byte("ICC_PROFILE"),
501			[]byte("iCCP"),
502			[]byte("ICCP"),
503			[]byte("cICP"),
504			[]byte("mDCv"),
505			[]byte("cLLi"),
506		} {
507			if bytes.Contains(data, marker) {
508				return true
509			}
510		}
511	
512		lowerData := strings.ToLower(string(data))
513		for _, marker := range []string{
514			"hdrgm:",
515			"hdr gain map",
516			"hdrgainmap",
517			"gainmap",
518			"ultrahdr",
519			"adobe:hdrgainmap",
520			"aux:hdr",
521			"auxiliaryimagetype",
522			"display p3",
523			"display-p3",
524			"rec.2020",
525			"bt.2020",
526			"arib-std-b67",
527			"smpte st 2084",
528		} {
529			if strings.Contains(lowerData, marker) {
530				return true
531			}
532		}
533	
534		return false
535	}

537	// readCachedThumbnail reads a thumbnail from the cache directory.
538	func (*FileServerService) readCachedThumbnail(path string) ([]byte, error) {
539		file, err := os.Open(path)
540		if err != nil {
541			return nil, err
542		}
543		defer file.Close()
544		return io.ReadAll(file)
545	}

547	// generateThumbnail creates a new thumbnail and saves it to disk.
548	func (s *FileServerService) generateThumbnail(ctx context.Context, attachment *store.Attachment, thumbnailPath string) ([]byte, error) {
549		reader, err := s.getAttachmentReader(ctx, attachment)
550		if err != nil {
551			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get attachment reader")
552		}
553		defer reader.Close()
554	
555		img, err := imaging.Decode(reader, imaging.AutoOrientation(true))
556		if err != nil {
557			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to decode image")
558		}
559	
560		width, height := img.Bounds().Dx(), img.Bounds().Dy()
561		thumbnailWidth, thumbnailHeight := calculateThumbnailDimensions(width, height)
562	
563		thumbnailImage := imaging.Resize(img, thumbnailWidth, thumbnailHeight, imaging.Lanczos)
564	
565		output, err := os.Create(thumbnailPath)
566		if err != nil {
567			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to create thumbnail file")
568		}
569		defer output.Close()
570	
571		if err := imaging.Encode(output, thumbnailImage, imaging.JPEG, imaging.JPEGQuality(90)); err != nil {
572			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to save thumbnail")
573		}
574	
575		return s.readCachedThumbnail(thumbnailPath)
576	}
577	
578	// calculateThumbnailDimensions calculates the target dimensions for a thumbnail.
579	// The largest dimension is constrained to thumbnailMaxSize while maintaining aspect ratio.
580	// Small images are not enlarged.
581	func calculateThumbnailDimensions(width, height int) (int, int) {
582		if max(width, height) <= thumbnailMaxSize {
583			return width, height
584		}
585		if width >= height {
586			return thumbnailMaxSize, 0 // Landscape: constrain width.
587		}
588		return 0, thumbnailMaxSize // Portrait: constrain height.
589	}

591	func (s *FileServerService) serveMotionClip(c *echo.Context, attachment *store.Attachment) error {
592		motionMedia := attachment.Payload.GetMotionMedia()
593		if motionMedia == nil || motionMedia.Family != storepb.MotionMediaFamily_ANDROID_MOTION_PHOTO || !motionMedia.HasEmbeddedVideo {
594			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusBadRequest, "attachment does not have motion clip")
595		}
596	
597		clipBlob, err := s.getOrExtractMotionClip(c.Request().Context(), attachment)
598		if err != nil {
599			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get motion clip").Wrap(err)
600		}
601	
602		setSecurityHeaders(c)
603		setMediaHeaders(c, "video/mp4", "video/mp4")
604		modTime := time.Unix(attachment.UpdatedTs, 0)
605		http.ServeContent(c.Response(), c.Request(), attachment.UID+".mp4", modTime, bytes.NewReader(clipBlob))
606		return nil
607	}

609	func (s *FileServerService) getOrExtractMotionClip(_ context.Context, attachment *store.Attachment) ([]byte, error) {
610		motionPath, err := s.getMotionPath(attachment)
611		if err != nil {
612			return nil, err
613		}
614	
615		if blob, err := s.readCachedThumbnail(motionPath); err == nil {
616			return blob, nil
617		}
618	
619		blob, err := s.getAttachmentBlob(attachment)
620		if err != nil {
621			return nil, err
622		}
623	
624		videoBlob, _ := motionphoto.ExtractVideo(blob)
625		if len(videoBlob) == 0 {
626			return nil, errors.New("motion video not found")
627		}
628	
629		if err := os.WriteFile(motionPath, videoBlob, 0644); err != nil {
630			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to cache motion clip")
631		}
632	
633		return videoBlob, nil
634	}

640		}

642		return filepath.Join(cacheFolder, attachment.UID+".mp4"), nil
643	}

648	
649	// checkAttachmentPermission verifies the user has permission to access the attachment.
650	func (s *FileServerService) checkAttachmentPermission(ctx context.Context, c *echo.Context, attachment *store.Attachment) error {
651		// For unlinked attachments, only the creator can access.
652		if attachment.MemoID == nil {
653			user, err := s.getCurrentUser(ctx, c)
654			if err != nil {
655				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get current user").Wrap(err)
656			}
657			if user == nil {
658				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized access")
659			}
660			if user.ID != attachment.CreatorID && user.Role != store.RoleAdmin {
661				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusForbidden, "forbidden access")
662			}
663			return nil
664		}
665	
666		memo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{ID: attachment.MemoID})
667		if err != nil {
668			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to find memo").Wrap(err)
669		}
670		if memo == nil {
671			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusNotFound, "memo not found")
672		}
673	
674		// Public-visibility attachments are served to anonymous visitors only when the
675		// instance allows anonymous access. On a private instance (no InstanceURL), the
676		// request must still resolve to an authenticated user or a valid share token below.
677		if memo.Visibility == store.Public && s.Profile.AllowAnonymous() {
678			return nil
679		}
680	
681		// Check share token fallback: allow access if request carries a valid, non-expired share token
682		// that was issued for this specific memo. This covers attachment requests made from the shared
683		// memo page for private or protected memos.
684		if shareToken := (*c).QueryParam("share_token"); shareToken != "" {
685			ms, err := s.Store.GetMemoShare(ctx, &store.FindMemoShare{UID: &shareToken})
686			if err == nil && ms != nil && !isMemoShareExpired(ms) && ms.MemoID == memo.ID {
687				return nil
688			}
689		}
690	
691		user, err := s.getCurrentUser(ctx, c)
692		if err != nil {
693			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get current user").Wrap(err)
694		}
695		if user == nil {
696			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized access")
697		}
698	
699		if memo.Visibility == store.Private && user.ID != memo.CreatorID && user.Role != store.RoleAdmin {
700			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusForbidden, "forbidden access")
701		}
702	
703		return nil
704	}
705	
706	// getCurrentUser retrieves the current authenticated user from the request.
707	// Authentication priority: Bearer token (Access Token V2 or PAT) > Refresh token cookie.
708	func (s *FileServerService) getCurrentUser(ctx context.Context, c *echo.Context) (*store.User, error) {
709		authHeader := c.Request().Header.Get(echo.HeaderAuthorization)
710		cookieHeader := c.Request().Header.Get("Cookie")
711		return s.authenticator.AuthenticateToUser(ctx, authHeader, cookieHeader)
712	}

715	func (s *FileServerService) getUserByUsername(ctx context.Context, identifier string) (*store.User, error) {
716		return s.Store.GetUser(ctx, &store.FindUser{Username: &identifier})

1. Find the HTTP/gRPC handler that serves profile images (likely in server/router/api/v1/)
2. Trace the function calls down to the storage/data layer
3. Map each hop: handler → store interface → driver implementation

Look for:
- GetUser or similar user retrieval endpoint
- Profile image serving (avatar, profile picture)
- User store methods (GetUser, FindUser, etc.)
- Database driver implementation (sqlite/postgres/mysql)

Provide the complete call chain from the HTTP handler through to the database driver, with each function name and its file path.

55	func (s *APIV1Service) ListUsers(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.ListUsersRequest) (*v1pb.ListUsersResponse, error) {
56		currentUser, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
57		if err != nil {
58			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user: %v", err)
59		}
60		if currentUser == nil {
61			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
62		}
63		if currentUser.Role != store.RoleAdmin {
64			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
65		}
66	
67		userFind := &store.FindUser{}
68	
69		if request.Filter != "" {
70			username, err := extractUsernameFromFilter(request.Filter)
71			if err != nil {
72				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid filter: %v", err)
73			}
74			if username != "" {
75				userFind.Username = &username
76			}
77		}
78	
79		var limit, offset int
80		if request.PageToken != "" {
81			var pageToken v1pb.PageToken
82			if err := unmarshalPageToken(request.PageToken, &pageToken); err != nil {
83				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid page token: %v", err)
84			}
85			limit = normalizePageSize(pageToken.Limit)
86			offset = max(int(pageToken.Offset), 0)
87		} else {
88			limit = normalizePageSize(request.PageSize)
89		}
90		// Fetch one extra row to detect whether a subsequent page exists.
91		limitPlusOne := limit + 1
92		userFind.Limit = &limitPlusOne
93		userFind.Offset = &offset
94	
95		users, err := s.Store.ListUsers(ctx, userFind)
96		if err != nil {
97			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list users: %v", err)
98		}
99	
100		nextPageToken := ""
101		if len(users) == limitPlusOne {
102			users = users[:limit]
103			nextPageToken, err = getPageToken(limit, offset+limit)
104			if err != nil {
105				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get next page token: %v", err)
106			}
107		}
108	
109		response := &v1pb.ListUsersResponse{
110			Users:         make([]*v1pb.User, 0, len(users)),
111			NextPageToken: nextPageToken,
112		}
113		for _, user := range users {
114			response.Users = append(response.Users, convertUserFromStore(user, currentUser))
115		}
116		return response, nil
117	}

119	func normalizeBatchUsernames(usernames []string) ([]string, int) {
120		uniqueUsernames := make([]string, 0, len(usernames))
121		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(usernames))
122		nonEmptyCount := 0
123		for _, username := range usernames {
124			username = strings.TrimSpace(username)
125			if username == "" {
126				continue
127			}
128			nonEmptyCount++
129			if _, ok := seen[username]; ok {
130				continue
131			}
132			seen[username] = struct{}{}
133			uniqueUsernames = append(uniqueUsernames, username)
134		}
135		return uniqueUsernames, nonEmptyCount
136	}

183	func (s *APIV1Service) CreateUser(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.CreateUserRequest) (*v1pb.User, error) {
184		// Get current user (might be nil for unauthenticated requests)
185		currentUser, _ := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
186	
187		if request.User == nil {
188			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "user is required")
189		}
190		if err := validateWritableUsername(request.User.Username); err != nil {
191			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid username: %s", request.User.Username)
192		}
193		if err := validatePassword(request.User.Password); err != nil {
194			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "%v", err)
195		}
196	
197		roleToAssign := store.RoleUser
198		if currentUser != nil && currentUser.Role == store.RoleAdmin {
199			// Authenticated ADMIN user can create users with any role specified in request
200			if request.User.Role != v1pb.User_ROLE_UNSPECIFIED {
201				roleToAssign = convertUserRoleToStore(request.User.Role)
202			}
203		} else {
204			limitOne := 1
205			allUsers, err := s.Store.ListUsers(ctx, &store.FindUser{Limit: &limitOne})
206			if err != nil {
207				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list users: %v", err)
208			}
209			if len(allUsers) == 0 {
210				roleToAssign = store.RoleAdmin
211				if !request.ValidateOnly {
212					passwordHash, err := bcrypt.GenerateFromPassword([]byte(request.User.Password), bcrypt.DefaultCost)
213					if err != nil {
214						return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to generate password hash: %v", err)
215					}
216					user, created, err := s.Store.CreateUserIfNoUsers(ctx, &store.User{
217						Username:     request.User.Username,
218						Role:         store.RoleAdmin,
219						Email:        request.User.Email,
220						Nickname:     request.User.DisplayName,
221						PasswordHash: string(passwordHash),
222					})
223					if err != nil {
224						return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create first user: %v", err)
225					}
226					if created {
227						return convertUserFromStore(user, user), nil
228					}
229					roleToAssign = store.RoleUser
230				}
231			}
232	
233			// Only allow user registration if it is enabled in the settings, or if the user is a superuser
234			if roleToAssign != store.RoleAdmin {
235				instanceGeneralSetting, err := s.Store.GetInstanceGeneralSetting(ctx)
236				if err != nil {
237					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get instance general setting, error: %v", err)
238				}
239				if instanceGeneralSetting.DisallowUserRegistration {
240					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "user registration is not allowed")
241				}
242				if instanceGeneralSetting.DisallowPasswordAuth {
243					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "password signup is not allowed")
244				}
245			}
246		}
247	
248		// If validate_only is true, just validate without creating
249		if request.ValidateOnly {
250			// Perform validation checks without actually creating the user
251			return &v1pb.User{
252				Username:    request.User.Username,
253				Email:       request.User.Email,
254				DisplayName: request.User.DisplayName,
255				Role:        convertUserRoleFromStore(roleToAssign),
256			}, nil
257		}
258	
259		passwordHash, err := bcrypt.GenerateFromPassword([]byte(request.User.Password), bcrypt.DefaultCost)
260		if err != nil {
261			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to generate password hash: %v", err)
262		}
263	
264		user, err := s.Store.CreateUser(ctx, &store.User{
265			Username:     request.User.Username,
266			Role:         roleToAssign,
267			Email:        request.User.Email,
268			Nickname:     request.User.DisplayName,
269			PasswordHash: string(passwordHash),
270		})
271		if err != nil {
272			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create user: %v", err)
273		}
274	
275		return convertUserFromStore(user, user), nil
276	}

278	func (s *APIV1Service) UpdateUser(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.UpdateUserRequest) (*v1pb.User, error) {
279		if request.User == nil {
280			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "user is required")

282		if request.UpdateMask == nil || len(request.UpdateMask.Paths) == 0 {
283			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "update mask is empty")
284		}
285		user, err := ResolveUserByName(ctx, s.Store, request.User.Name)
286		if err != nil {
287			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid user name: %v", err)
288		}
289		if user == nil {
290			if request.AllowMissing {
291				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "user not found")
292			}
293			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "user not found")
294		}
295		userID := user.ID
296		currentUser, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
297		if err != nil {
298			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user: %v", err)
299		}
300		if currentUser == nil {
301			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
302		}
303		// Check permission.
304		// Only allow admin or self to update user.
305		if currentUser.ID != userID && currentUser.Role != store.RoleAdmin {
306			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
307		}
308	
309		currentTs := time.Now().Unix()
310		update := &store.UpdateUser{
311			ID:        user.ID,
312			UpdatedTs: &currentTs,
313		}
314		instanceGeneralSetting, err := s.Store.GetInstanceGeneralSetting(ctx)
315		if err != nil {
316			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get instance general setting: %v", err)
317		}
318		for _, field := range request.UpdateMask.Paths {
319			switch field {
320			case "username":
321				if instanceGeneralSetting.DisallowChangeUsername {
322					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied: disallow change username")
323				}
324				if err := validateWritableUsername(request.User.Username); err != nil {
325					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid username: %s", request.User.Username)
326				}
327				update.Username = &request.User.Username
328			case "display_name":
329				if instanceGeneralSetting.DisallowChangeNickname {
330					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied: disallow change nickname")
331				}
332				update.Nickname = &request.User.DisplayName
333			case "email":
334				update.Email = &request.User.Email
335			case "avatar_url":
336				// Validate avatar MIME type to prevent XSS during upload
337				if request.User.AvatarUrl != "" {
338					imageType, _, err := extractImageInfo(request.User.AvatarUrl)

340						return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid avatar format: %v", err)
341					}
342					// Only allow safe image formats for avatars
343					allowedAvatarTypes := map[string]bool{
344						"image/png":  true,
345						"image/jpeg": true,
346						"image/jpg":  true,
347						"image/gif":  true,
348						"image/webp": true,
349					}
350					if !allowedAvatarTypes[imageType] {
351						return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid avatar image type: %s. Only PNG, JPEG, GIF, and WebP are allowed", imageType)
352					}
353				}
354				update.AvatarURL = &request.User.AvatarUrl
355			case "description":
356				update.Description = &request.User.Description
357			case "role":
358				// Only allow admin to update role.
359				if currentUser.Role != store.RoleAdmin {
360					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
361				}
362				role := convertUserRoleToStore(request.User.Role)
363				update.Role = &role
364			case "password":
365				if err := validatePassword(request.User.Password); err != nil {
366					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "%v", err)
367				}
368				passwordHash, err := bcrypt.GenerateFromPassword([]byte(request.User.Password), bcrypt.DefaultCost)
369				if err != nil {
370					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to generate password hash: %v", err)
371				}
372				passwordHashStr := string(passwordHash)
373				update.PasswordHash = &passwordHashStr
374			case "state":
375				if currentUser.Role != store.RoleAdmin {
376					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
377				}
378				rowStatus := convertStateToStore(request.User.State)
379				update.RowStatus = &rowStatus
380			default:
381				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid update path: %s", field)
382			}
383		}
384	
385		updatedUser, err := s.Store.UpdateUser(ctx, update)
386		if err != nil {
387			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to update user: %v", err)
388		}
389	
390		return convertUserFromStore(updatedUser, currentUser), nil
391	}

120	// RegisterRoutes registers HTTP file serving routes.
121	func (s *FileServerService) RegisterRoutes(echoServer *echo.Echo) {
122		fileGroup := echoServer.Group("/file")

131	// serveAttachmentFile serves attachment binary content using native HTTP.
132	func (s *FileServerService) serveAttachmentFile(c *echo.Context) error {
133		ctx := c.Request().Context()
134		uid := c.Param("uid")
135		wantThumbnail := c.QueryParam("thumbnail") == "true"
136		wantMotion := c.QueryParam("motion") == "true"
137	
138		attachment, err := s.Store.GetAttachment(ctx, &store.FindAttachment{
139			UID:     &uid,
140			GetBlob: true,
141		})
142		if err != nil {
143			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get attachment").Wrap(err)
144		}
145		if attachment == nil {
146			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusNotFound, "attachment not found")
147		}
148	
149		if err := s.checkAttachmentPermission(ctx, c, attachment); err != nil {
150			return err
151		}
152	
153		if wantMotion {
154			return s.serveMotionClip(c, attachment)
155		}
156	
157		contentType := s.sanitizeContentType(attachment.Type)
158	
159		// Stream video/audio to avoid loading entire file into memory.
160		if isMediaType(attachment.Type) {
161			return s.serveMediaStream(c, attachment, contentType)
162		}
163	
164		return s.serveStaticFile(c, attachment, contentType, wantThumbnail)
165	}

167	// serveUserAvatar serves user avatar images.
168	func (s *FileServerService) serveUserAvatar(c *echo.Context) error {
169		ctx := c.Request().Context()
170	
171		// On a private instance (no InstanceURL), avatars are not exposed to anonymous
172		// visitors; a valid session, access token, or PAT is required.
173		if !s.Profile.AllowAnonymous() {
174			viewer, err := s.getCurrentUser(ctx, c)
175			if err != nil {
176				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get current user").Wrap(err)
177			}
178			if viewer == nil {
179				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized access")
180			}
181		}
182	
183		identifier := c.Param("identifier")
184	
185		user, err := s.getUserByUsername(ctx, identifier)
186		if err != nil {
187			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get user").Wrap(err)
188		}
189		if user == nil {
190			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusNotFound, "user not found")
191		}
192		if user.AvatarURL == "" {
193			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusNotFound, "avatar not found")
194		}
195	
196		imageType, imageData, err := s.parseDataURI(user.AvatarURL)
197		if err != nil {
198			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to parse avatar data").Wrap(err)
199		}
200	
201		if !avatarAllowedTypes[imageType] {
202			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid avatar image type")
203		}
204	
205		setSecurityHeaders(c)
206		c.Response().Header().Set(echo.HeaderContentType, imageType)
207		c.Response().Header().Set(echo.HeaderCacheControl, cacheMaxAge)
208	
209		return c.Blob(http.StatusOK, imageType, imageData)
210	}

216	// serveMediaStream serves video/audio files using streaming to avoid memory exhaustion.
217	func (s *FileServerService) serveMediaStream(c *echo.Context, attachment *store.Attachment, contentType string) error {
218		setSecurityHeaders(c)
219		setMediaHeaders(c, contentType, attachment.Type)
220	
221		switch attachment.StorageType {
222		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_LOCAL:
223			filePath, err := s.resolveLocalPath(attachment.Reference)
224			if err != nil {
225				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to resolve file path").Wrap(err)
226			}
227			http.ServeFile(c.Response(), c.Request(), filePath)
228			return nil
229	
230		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_S3:
231			presignURL, err := s.getS3PresignedURL(c.Request().Context(), attachment)
232			if err != nil {
233				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to generate presigned URL").Wrap(err)
234			}
235			return c.Redirect(http.StatusTemporaryRedirect, presignURL)
236	
237		default:
238			// Database storage fallback.
239			modTime := time.Unix(attachment.UpdatedTs, 0)
240			http.ServeContent(c.Response(), c.Request(), attachment.Filename, modTime, bytes.NewReader(attachment.Blob))
241			return nil
242		}
243	}
